title: 新加坡大士南焚化廠
summary: 以大士南設備更新為案例，學習把鍋爐、吹灰、灰渣輸送、煙氣處理與起重設備視為相互依賴的系統；延役須有性能證據。
summaryEn: Using Tuas South refurbishment, treat boilers, soot blowing, ash transport, gas cleaning and cranes as interdependent systems; life extension requires performance evidence.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 進料品質基線：垃圾熱值與熱輸入：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Feed-quality baseline: Waste heating value and heat input: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 進料品質基線：垃圾熱值與熱輸入 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Feed-quality baseline: Waste heating value and heat input and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 熱輸入由垃圾質量流率及低位熱值決定；水分、惰性物與可燃成分會使同噸數產生不同熱量。本單元在「進料品質基線」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Heat input depends on waste mass flow and lower heating value; moisture, inert material and combustibles change energy at the same tonnage. Examine this relationship at feed-quality baseline.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：m=10 t/h、LHV=8 MJ/kg。公式 Pthermal=m LHV/3.6；代入 10*8/3.6 = 22.22222 MW。適用邊界：熱輸入示範，不是爐體操作限值或爐排設計。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: m=10 t/h andLHV=8 MJ/kg. Formula Pthermal=m LHV/3.6; substitution 10*8/3.6 = 22.22222 MW. Boundary: Heat-input example, not a furnace operating limit or grate design.
steps.failure: 高含水垃圾可使熱值下降；只依噸數預測發電會偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Wet waste reduces heating value; tonnage alone mispredicts power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 以代表性混合樣估熱值，核對秤重與蒸汽生成趨勢。在離線場景為「進料品質基線」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Estimate heating value from representative composite samples and compare weighbridge and steam trends. Build an offline evidence table for feed-quality baseline; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「進料品質基線」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把LHV改成6 MJ/kg，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 MW。與基準 22.22222 MW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the feed-quality baseline measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only LHV to6 MJ/kg with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 MW. Compare with baseline 22.22222 MW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
相同垃圾噸數必定產生相同熱量。
optionsEn: Heat input depends on waste mass flow and lower heating value; moisture, inert material and combustibles change energy at the same tonnage.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Equal waste tonnage always provides equal heat.

Build an offline evidence table for feed-quality baseline; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Refurbished boiler duty: Steam enthalpy rise and boiler duty and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 鍋爐將水的焓提高到蒸汽狀態；應用焓差而不是單靠出口溫度計算熱量。本單元在「更新鍋爐熱量帳」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: A boiler raises feedwater enthalpy to steam conditions; use enthalpy difference rather than outlet temperature alone. Examine this relationship at refurbished boiler duty.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：蒸汽流率5 kg/s、蒸汽與給水焓差2400 kJ/kg。公式 Psteam=m Δh/1000；代入 5*2400/1000 = 12 MW。適用邊界：假想查表焓值已給定；未含排污、蒸汽品質與非穩態。

Formula Psteam=m Δh/1000; substitution 5*2400/1000 = 12 MW. Boundary: Hypothetical tabulated enthalpy difference supplied; blowdown, quality and transients excluded.

steps.failureEn: Mixing saturated and superheated states gives an incorrect energy balance. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

knowledge.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：實際氣量Q=60000 m³/h、有效濾布A=1000 m²。公式 v=Q/(60A)；代入 60000/(60*1000) = 1 m/min。適用邊界：採實際溫度氣量，不可直接把Nm³當m³；非設備選型限值。

steps.title: 排放質量與有效資料：煙氣濃度與排放質量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Emission mass and valid data: Flue-gas concentration and emission mass: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 排放質量與有效資料：煙氣濃度與排放質量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Emission mass and valid data: Flue-gas concentration and emission mass and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 排放質量率取決於濃度乘氣體體積流率；濕乾基、氧校正與標準狀態必須一致。本單元在「排放質量與有效資料」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Emission mass rate is concentration times gas flow; wet/dry basis, oxygen correction and standard conditions must agree. Examine this relationship at emission mass and valid data.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：C=20 mg/Nm³、乾基Q=100000 Nm³/h，兩者同基準。公式 M=CQ/1000000；代入 20*100000/1000000 = 2 kg/h。適用邊界：同基準的示範排放帳；不是任何地區法定排放限值。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: C=20 mg/Nm³ and dryQ=100000 Nm³/h on the same basis. Formula M=CQ/1000000; substitution 20*100000/1000000 = 2 kg/h. Boundary: Same-basis illustrative emissions ledger, not a statutory limit.
steps.failure: 稀釋煙氣可降濃度卻不降污染質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Diluting flue gas lowers concentration without lowering pollutant mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同步氣量、濃度與氧含量，查校正狀態及無效資料標記。在離線場景為「排放質量與有效資料」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize gas flow, concentration and oxygen while checking calibration and invalid-data flags. Build an offline evidence table for emission mass and valid data; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 灰渣輸送介面：灰渣分流與質量帳 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Ash-conveyance interface: Ash-stream separation and mass balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 底渣與飛灰來源、污染物分布及處置需求不同，必須分流記錄；金屬回收不等於殘渣自動合格。本單元在「灰渣輸送介面」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Bottom ash and fly ash differ in origin, contaminant distribution and management needs; keep separate ledgers, and metal recovery does not automatically certify residues. Examine this relationship at ash-conveyance interface.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：垃圾100 t/d、假想底渣分率0.20、飛灰分率0.03。公式 Mash=Mw(fbottom+ffly)；代入 100*(0.20+0.03) = 23 t/d。適用邊界：假想濕乾基一致的分率，非實際廠產率；須另考慮添加劑與水分。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: waste100 t/d, assumed bottom-ash fraction0.20 and fly-ash fraction0.03. Formula Mash=Mw(fbottom+ffly); substitution 100*(0.20+0.03) = 23 t/d. Boundary: Hypothetical consistent moisture basis, not actual plant yield; additives and moisture require separate entries.

steps.failureEn: Mixing bottom and fly ash loses traceability and treatment distinctions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

steps.checkEn: Weigh each stream, take representative samples and retain disposal and quality records. Build an offline evidence table for ash-conveyance interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instructionEn:
Weigh each stream, take representative samples and retain disposal and quality records. Build an offline evidence table for ash-conveyance interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare with baseline 23 t/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

steps.title: 更新後廠用電：淨電力與廠用負載：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Post-refit auxiliaries: Net electricity and auxiliary loads: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 更新後廠用電：淨電力與廠用負載 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Post-refit auxiliaries: Net electricity and auxiliary loads and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 能源自給須以同一邊界比較可用發電與所有廠用電；年度淨額不代表每小時離網。本單元在「更新後廠用電」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Energy self-sufficiency compares usable generation and all internal loads within one boundary; an annual net balance does not prove hourly islanded operation. Examine this relationship at post-refit auxiliaries.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：發電5000 kWh/d、曝氣2800、泵600、其他400 kWh/d。公式 Enet=Eg-Ea-Ep-Eother；代入 5000-2800-600-400 = 1200 kWh/d。適用邊界：示範日帳，未含備援燃料與尖峰電力容量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: generation5000 kWh/d, aeration2800, pumping600 and other loads400 kWh/d. Formula Enet=Eg-Ea-Ep-Eother; substitution 5000-2800-600-400 = 1200 kWh/d. Boundary: Illustrative daily ledger; reserve fuel and peak power capacity are omitted.
steps.failure: 漏掉臭氣處理與污泥設備用電會誇大淨盈餘。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Omitting odor and sludge equipment overstates net surplus. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 核對發電、購電與售電表，在相同邊界做全年帳。在離線場景為「更新後廠用電」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Reconcile generation, imports and exports within the same boundary over a year. Build an offline evidence table for post-refit auxiliaries; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 新舊儀表一致性：感測器偏移校正：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Old/new sensor consistency: Sensor offset calibration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 新舊儀表一致性：感測器偏移校正 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Old/new sensor consistency: Sensor offset calibration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「新舊儀表一致性」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at old/new sensor consistency.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
steps.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「新舊儀表一致性」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for old/new sensor consistency; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。

steps.instruction: 干預前後差異還可能包含天氣與背景趨勢；前後—對照差分可分離共同變化但仍須檢查可比性。本單元在「氣候與垃圾組成對照」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Before-after changes include weather and background trends; difference-in-differences removes common changes but still needs comparable sites. Examine this relationship at weather/composition controls.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：處理地由30降至27，對照地由29降至28，同一指標。公式 effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore)；代入 (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit。適用邊界：假設共同背景趨勢；不是隨機試驗或完全因果證明。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: treated site30 to27 and control site29 to28 for the same indicator. Formula effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore); substitution (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit. Boundary: Common background trend assumed; not a randomized trial or complete causal proof.

steps.checkEn: Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for weather/composition controls; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 城市集水區與暴雨邊界：集水面積與逕流量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Urban catchment and storm boundary: Catchment area and runoff volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 城市集水區與暴雨邊界：集水面積與逕流量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Urban catchment and storm boundary: Catchment area and runoff volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「城市集水區與暴雨邊界」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at urban catchment and storm boundary.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
steps.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「城市集水區與暴雨邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for urban catchment and storm boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 維持用水來源配對：回用水混合與需求配對 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Maintenance-water source matching: Reuse blending and demand matching and its observable causal relationships.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Channel section and pedestrian space: Velocity and flow area and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 連續方程 Q=Av 將流量連到平均流速；局部收縮與阻塞提高流速及水頭損失。本單元在「溪床斷面與人行空間」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Continuity Q=Av links discharge to mean velocity; local contraction and blockage increase velocity and head loss. Examine this relationship at channel section and pedestrian space.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：流量 Q=0.9 m³/s、有效面積 A=0.6 m²。公式 v=Q/A；代入 0.9/0.6 = 1.5 m/s。適用邊界：均勻平均流；不能用平均流速判定局部沖刷或人員安全。

steps.objective: 辨識 補注供水能源帳：提升水頭與電力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Maintenance-supply energy ledger: Lift head and electrical power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「補注供水能源帳」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at maintenance-supply energy ledger.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.

steps.checkEn: Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for maintenance-supply energy ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: 遮蔭減少短波吸收，但人體熱感還受到風、長波輻射與濕度影響。本單元在「沿岸遮蔭樣區」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Shade reduces absorbed shortwave radiation, while human thermal sensation also depends on wind, longwave radiation and humidity. Examine this relationship at riverside shade plots.

steps.checkEn: Measure shaded/unshaded surface temperature, radiation and wind concurrently. Build an offline evidence table for riverside shade plots; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：面積100 m²、入射600 W/m²、吸收率0.70、遮蔭減少入射0.60。公式 ΔP=A I α fshade/1000；代入 100*600*0.70*0.60/1000 = 25.2 kW。適用邊界：單一表面瞬時短波示範，不直接預測氣溫或體感溫度。

steps.title: 狹長河岸棲地：生態廊道與可用棲地：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Linear riparian habitat: Ecological corridors and usable habitat: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 狹長河岸棲地：生態廊道與可用棲地 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Linear riparian habitat: Ecological corridors and usable habitat and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 綠地面積與真正連通的可用棲地不同；硬質障礙、照明與維護方式影響動植物通行。本單元在「狹長河岸棲地」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Green area differs from connected usable habitat; hard barriers, lighting and maintenance affect movement. Examine this relationship at linear riparian habitat.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：廊道長800 m、平均有效寬度12 m。公式 A=Lw；代入 800*12 = 9600 m²。適用邊界：幾何面積近似，不是物種存活率或生態服務價值。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: corridor length800 m and mean effective width12 m. Formula A=Lw; substitution 800*12 = 9600 m². Boundary: Geometric-area approximation, not survival probability or ecosystem-service valuation.
steps.failure: 廊道被道路切斷時，相同面積仍可能失去連通。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A road break can destroy connectivity despite unchanged area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 在地圖標斷點，搭配定點觀察確認指定物種是否實際使用。在離線場景為「狹長河岸棲地」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Map breaks and use fixed observations to verify use by specified species. Build an offline evidence table for linear riparian habitat; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete the measurement/model exercise for Linear riparian habitat: Ecological corridors and usable habitat and record deviations from assumptions.
steps.instruction:
在地圖標斷點，搭配定點觀察確認指定物種是否實際使用。在離線場景為「狹長河岸棲地」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
操作任務：先點選「狹長河岸棲地」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效寬度減成8 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6400 m²。與基準 9600 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
steps.instructionEn:
Map breaks and use fixed observations to verify use by specified species. Build an offline evidence table for linear riparian habitat; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
Action: Select the linear riparian habitat measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only effective width to8 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6400 m². Compare with baseline 9600 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：廊道長800 m、平均有效寬度12 m。公式 A=Lw；代入 800*12 = 9600 m²。適用邊界：幾何面積近似，不是物種存活率或生態服務價值。

steps.title: 物種與季節調查：棲地樣區與多樣性指標：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Species and seasonal surveys: Habitat plots and diversity indicators: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 物種與季節調查：棲地樣區與多樣性指標 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Species and seasonal surveys: Habitat plots and diversity indicators and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: Simpson多樣性以物種比例衡量優勢程度；指標增加不等於所有原生物種都恢復。本單元在「物種與季節調查」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Simpson diversity measures dominance through species proportions; a larger index does not prove recovery of every native species. Examine this relationship at species and seasonal surveys.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：四類生物比例0.4、0.3、0.2、0.1。公式 D=1-Σpi²；代入 1-(0.4**2+0.3**2+0.2**2+0.1**2) = 0.7 index。適用邊界：相同採樣方法與努力量；不替代保育物種與外來種調查。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: four taxon proportions0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1. Formula D=1-Σpi²; substitution 1-(0.4**2+0.3**2+0.2**2+0.1**2) = 0.7 index. Boundary: Same sampling method and effort; not a replacement for protected- and invasive-species surveys.
steps.failure: 採樣努力量增加會製造看似改善，須對照基線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Greater sampling effort can mimic improvement; compare with the baseline. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 固定樣區、季節與採樣時長，另記棲地連續性與外來種。在離線場景為「物種與季節調查」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Fix plots, season and effort and separately record connectivity and invasive species. Build an offline evidence table for species and seasonal surveys; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 水位水質監測對照：感測器偏移校正：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Level/quality sensor comparison: Sensor offset calibration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水位水質監測對照：感測器偏移校正 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Level/quality sensor comparison: Sensor offset calibration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「水位水質監測對照」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at level/quality sensor comparison.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
steps.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「水位水質監測對照」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for level/quality sensor comparison; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 上游集水與公園入口：集水面積與逕流量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Upstream catchment and park entry: Catchment area and runoff volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 上游集水與公園入口：集水面積與逕流量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Upstream catchment and park entry: Catchment area and runoff volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「上游集水與公園入口」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at upstream catchment and park entry.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。

steps.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「上游集水與公園入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for upstream catchment and park entry; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 土壤入滲試驗區：入滲容量與堵塞：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Soil-infiltration trial plots: Infiltration capacity and clogging: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 土壤入滲試驗區：入滲容量與堵塞 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Soil-infiltration trial plots: Infiltration capacity and clogging and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 表觀入滲率乘有效面積估算短時入滲能力；降雨前土壤濕度與細粒堵塞會改變它。本單元在「土壤入滲試驗區」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Apparent infiltration rate times active area estimates short-duration intake; antecedent moisture and fine-particle clogging change it. Examine this relationship at soil-infiltration trial plots.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：入滲率f=10 mm/h、面積A=500 m²。公式 Qinf=fA/1000；代入 10*500/1000 = 5 m³/h。適用邊界：短時均勻近似，未包括地下水抬升與非飽和動力學。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: infiltrationf=10 mm/h and areaA=500 m². Formula Qinf=fA/1000; substitution 10*500/1000 = 5 m³/h. Boundary: Short-duration uniform approximation; groundwater rise and unsaturated dynamics excluded.
steps.failure: 表面細砂堵塞會讓原設計入滲值失效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Fine-sediment surface clogging invalidates the original infiltration estimate. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 多位置入滲試驗並記錄前期濕度，檢查溢流路徑。在離線場景為「土壤入滲試驗區」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Test infiltration at several positions, record antecedent moisture and inspect overflow routes. Build an offline evidence table for soil-infiltration trial plots; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.text: 先點選「土壤入滲試驗區」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把f降成4 mm/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 m³/h。與基準 5 m³/h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the soil-infiltration trial plots measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only f to4 mm/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 m³/h. Compare with baseline 5 m³/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

steps.title: 彎曲河道通洪：重力輸送與粗糙度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Meandering-channel conveyance: Gravity conveyance and roughness: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 彎曲河道通洪：重力輸送與粗糙度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Meandering-channel conveyance: Gravity conveyance and roughness and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: Manning 模型以水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度表示明渠平均輸送能力；加粗表面會降低同水位的流量。本單元在「彎曲河道通洪」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: The Manning model relates open-channel capacity to hydraulic radius, slope and roughness; greater roughness reduces discharge at the same depth. Examine this relationship at meandering-channel conveyance.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：A=4 m²、R=0.8 m、S=0.001、n=0.015。公式 Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2)；代入 (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s。適用邊界：穩定均勻明渠近似；滿管壓力、回水與跌水需另建模。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: A=4 m², R=0.8 m, S=0.001 and n=0.015. Formula Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2); substitution (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s. Boundary: Steady uniform open-channel approximation; pressure flow, backwater and drops require separate models.
steps.failure: 沉積與生物膜改變粗糙度，沿用初建值可能高估能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Sediment and biofilm alter roughness; an as-built value may overestimate capacity. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 量測縱坡與斷面，校準不同水位的流量曲線。在離線場景為「彎曲河道通洪」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure slope and section and calibrate the discharge curve at several depths. Build an offline evidence table for meandering-channel conveyance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: 遮蔭減少短波吸收，但人體熱感還受到風、長波輻射與濕度影響。本單元在「樹冠與活動區熱暴露」觀察此因果關係。

steps.title: 水位警示資料品質：感測器偏移校正：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Level-warning data quality: Sensor offset calibration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水位警示資料品質：感測器偏移校正 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Level-warning data quality: Sensor offset calibration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「水位警示資料品質」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at level-warning data quality.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
steps.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「水位警示資料品質」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for level-warning data quality; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 污染分區與乾土盤點：土壤污染質量與範圍：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 污染分區與乾土盤點：土壤污染質量與範圍 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Contamination zoning and dry-soil inventory: Soil contaminant mass and extent and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染濃度乘乾土質量估計污染庫存；空間異質性與土壤體積密度會控制不確定度。本單元在「污染分區與乾土盤點」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Concentration times dry-soil mass estimates contaminant inventory; spatial heterogeneity and bulk density govern uncertainty. Examine this relationship at contamination zoning and dry-soil inventory.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾土1000 t、代表性濃度200 mg/kg。公式 Mcontaminant=Msoil C/1000；代入 1000*200/1000 = 200 kg。適用邊界：代表性平均濃度假設，不能替代熱點與暴露途徑調查。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry soil1000 t and representative concentration200 mg/kg. Formula Mcontaminant=Msoil C/1000; substitution 1000*200/1000 = 200 kg. Boundary: Representative mean concentration assumed; hotspots and exposure pathways need separate investigation.

steps.failureEn: Diluting the mean with clean areas hides hotspots. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 建立採樣網格與深度分層，查檢出限、重複樣及空白樣。在離線場景為「污染分區與乾土盤點」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Create a sampling grid and depth strata, checking detection limits, duplicates and blanks. Build an offline evidence table for contamination zoning and dry-soil inventory; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instructionEn: When contamination associates with fines, separation can recover coarse soil while concentrating contamination in sludge; this separates rather than destroys it. Examine this relationship at wash-plant fractionation.

steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: total contaminant100 kg with80% entering20 t dry fines. steps.checkEn: Weigh size fractions and analyze fines, coarse soil and washwater to check all destinations. Build an offline evidence table for wash-plant fractionation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 洗水循環污染帳：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Recirculated-washwater pollutant ledger: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 洗水循環污染帳：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Recirculated-washwater pollutant ledger: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「洗水循環污染帳」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at recirculated-washwater pollutant ledger.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「洗水循環污染帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for recirculated-washwater pollutant ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 細料與洗水固液分離：表面溢流率與沉降分離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Fines/washwater separation: Surface loading and settling separation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「細料與洗水固液分離」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at fines/washwater separation.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
steps.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「細料與洗水固液分離」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for fines/washwater separation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 回填批次追溯：整治材料回用與獨立驗收：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Accepted-backfill batch traceability: Remediated-material reuse and independent acceptance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 回填批次追溯：整治材料回用與獨立驗收 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Accepted-backfill batch traceability: Remediated-material reuse and independent acceptance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 回用比例只計入通過用途相符驗收的材料；處理過不代表所有粒級、所有污染物或所有用途均已合格。本單元在「回填批次追溯」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Reuse fraction includes only material accepted for its intended use; treatment alone does not qualify every size fraction, contaminant or end use. Examine this relationship at accepted-backfill batch traceability.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：處理乾土1000 t、符合指定回用條件760 t。公式 r=100 maccepted/minput；代入 100*760/1000 = 76 %。適用邊界：教學驗收條件由題目假定，不代表任何司法管轄區標準；另查力學與浸出性質。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: treated dry soil1000 t and760 t meeting specified reuse acceptance. Formula r=100 maccepted/minput; substitution 100*760/1000 = 76 %. Boundary: Acceptance is hypothetical, not a jurisdictional standard; geotechnical and leaching properties need separate checks.
steps.failure: 把待驗材料算入回用會高估成果；先隔離待驗批次再更新帳。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Counting material awaiting testing inflates reuse; separate pending batches before updating the ledger. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 把每批採樣結果與回填位置綁定，保留不合格細料及出場聯單。在離線場景為「回填批次追溯」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Link each batch sample to its placement and retain rejected-fines and off-site transfer records. Build an offline evidence table for accepted-backfill batch traceability; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 地下水源—途徑—受體：補注與達西流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Groundwater source-pathway-receptor: Recharge and Darcy flow: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 地下水源—途徑—受體：補注與達西流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Groundwater source-pathway-receptor: Recharge and Darcy flow and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 飽和多孔介質中的達西通量取決於水力傳導係數與梯度；達西流速不是孔隙內水的速度。本單元在「地下水源—途徑—受體」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Darcy flux in saturated porous media depends on hydraulic conductivity and gradient; it is not the pore-water velocity. Examine this relationship at groundwater source-pathway-receptor.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：K=5 m/d、梯度i=0.02、截面A=2000 m²。公式 Q=KiA；代入 5*0.02*2000 = 200 m³/d。適用邊界：均質飽和一維近似；不處理裂隙優勢流或非飽和區。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: K=5 m/d, gradienti=0.02 and cross-sectionA=2000 m². Formula Q=KiA; substitution 5*0.02*2000 = 200 m³/d. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated one-dimensional approximation; fractures and the unsaturated zone are excluded.
steps.failure: 細粒堵塞可降低K，即使水頭相同補注率仍會下降。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Fine-particle clogging can reduce K and recharge at the same head. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 以觀測井水頭求梯度，分開估計K與有效孔隙率。在離線場景為「地下水源—途徑—受體」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Use observation-well heads to estimate gradient and estimate K separately from effective porosity. Build an offline evidence table for groundwater source-pathway-receptor; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾土1000 t、代表性濃度200 mg/kg。公式 Mcontaminant=Msoil C/1000；代入 1000*200/1000 = 200 kg。適用邊界：代表性平均濃度假設，不能替代熱點與暴露途徑調查。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry soil1000 t and representative concentration200 mg/kg. Formula Mcontaminant=Msoil C/1000; substitution 1000*200/1000 = 200 kg. Boundary: Representative mean concentration assumed; hotspots and exposure pathways need separate investigation.

title: 紐約 Freshkills 公園掩埋場復育
summary: Freshkills的公園功能建立在掩埋場工程覆蓋與持續監測之上。學徒要把雨水、滲出水、氣體、沉陷和植被畫成分開但互相影響的路徑。
summaryEn: Freshkills park functions above engineered landfill containment and monitoring. Learners separate, then reconnect, stormwater, leachate, gas, settlement and vegetation pathways.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 覆蓋層水量邊界：覆蓋層水量平衡：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Cover-system water balance: Cover-system water balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 覆蓋層水量邊界：覆蓋層水量平衡 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Cover-system water balance: Cover-system water balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 降雨被分成逕流、蒸散、儲水變化與向下滲漏；綠色覆蓋並不表示滲漏已受控制。本單元在「覆蓋層水量邊界」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Rain partitions into runoff, evapotranspiration, storage change and percolation; green cover does not prove leakage control. Examine this relationship at cover-system water balance.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：P=100、R=30、ET=40、ΔS=10 mm，同一期間。公式 Perc=P-R-ET-ΔS；代入 100-30-40-10 = 20 mm。適用邊界：面積平均帳，未表示襯層缺陷造成的局部滲漏。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: P=100, R=30, ET=40 andΔS=10 mm over the same period. Formula Perc=P-R-ET-ΔS; substitution 100-30-40-10 = 20 mm. Boundary: Area-average ledger; localized leakage through liner defects is not represented.
steps.failure: 沉陷破壞排水坡度會造成積水與局部滲漏。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Settlement can reverse drainage slopes, causing ponding and local leakage. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 比較氣象、水位與滲出水流量，檢查季節儲水變化。在離線場景為「覆蓋層水量邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare weather, water levels and leachate flow and inspect seasonal storage. Build an offline evidence table for cover-system water balance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 坡面雨水逕流：集水面積與逕流量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Slope stormwater runoff: Catchment area and runoff volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 坡面雨水逕流：集水面積與逕流量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Slope stormwater runoff: Catchment area and runoff volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「坡面雨水逕流」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at slope stormwater runoff.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
steps.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「坡面雨水逕流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for slope stormwater runoff; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 排水溝與滯洪退水：退水時間與恢復使用：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Ditch and detention drawdown: Drawdown time and return to use: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 排水溝與滯洪退水：退水時間與恢復使用 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Ditch and detention drawdown: Drawdown time and return to use and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 暫存水需在下次事件前排空並確認使用條件；退水時間由可用排水流量決定。本單元在「排水溝與滯洪退水」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Stored water needs drawdown before the next event and a check before public use; available discharge governs drawdown time. Examine this relationship at ditch and detention drawdown.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：待排水V=180 m³、定流量Q=15 m³/h。公式 t=V/Q；代入 180/15 = 12 h。適用邊界：固定出流示範；孔口出流隨水頭下降須積分計算。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: stored waterV=180 m³ and constant dischargeQ=15 m³/h. Formula t=V/Q; substitution 180/15 = 12 h. Boundary: Constant-flow illustration; orifice discharge declining with head needs integration.
steps.failure: 出水口被落葉堵塞會延長不可用時間。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Leaf-blocked outlets lengthen unavailable time. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 以水位記錄核對退水曲線，巡查積水與污物後才恢復場地。在離線場景為「排水溝與滯洪退水」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Check the drawdown curve against level data and inspect standing water and debris before reopening. Build an offline evidence table for ditch and detention drawdown; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 掩埋氣收集支線：掩埋氣體收集與逸散：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Landfill-gas collection laterals: Landfill-gas capture and fugitive loss: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 掩埋氣收集支線：掩埋氣體收集與逸散 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Landfill-gas collection laterals: Landfill-gas capture and fugitive loss and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 抽取井收集的氣體只占產氣一部分；必須區分產生、收集、氧化與逸散。本單元在「掩埋氣收集支線」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Collection wells capture only part of generated gas; distinguish generation, collection, oxidation and fugitive emissions. Examine this relationship at landfill-gas collection laterals.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想甲烷產生1000 Nm³/d、收集率0.70。公式 Vuncaptured=Vgenerated(1-fcapture)；代入 1000*(1-0.70) = 300 Nm³/d。適用邊界：未收集不全等於排到大氣，覆土氧化需另外估計。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical methane generation1000 Nm³/d and capture fraction0.70. Formula Vuncaptured=Vgenerated(1-fcapture); substitution 1000*(1-0.70) = 300 Nm³/d. Boundary: Uncaptured gas is not all atmospheric emission; cover oxidation needs separate estimation.
steps.failure: 過度抽氣引入空氣可能改變氣體品質與火災風險。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Excess extraction can draw in air, changing gas quality and fire risk. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 結合井場流量、表面巡測與覆層資料，不只看總管抽氣量。在離線場景為「掩埋氣收集支線」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Combine well-field flow, surface surveys and cover information rather than header flow alone. Build an offline evidence table for landfill-gas collection laterals; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 不均勻沉陷巡測：差異沉陷與地形坡度：機制與觀察

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Differential-settlement survey: Differential settlement and surface slope and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 兩點差異沉陷改變排水坡度，影響覆層完整性、管線與公共設施；平均沉陷不足以判讀。本單元在「不均勻沉陷巡測」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Differential settlement changes drainage grade and stresses covers, pipes and public facilities; mean settlement is insufficient. Examine this relationship at differential-settlement survey.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩點距離L=20 m、差異沉陷Δs=0.10 m。公式 Δslope=100Δs/L；代入 100*0.10/20 = 0.5 %。適用邊界：小變形幾何示範，不是邊坡穩定或地基承載分析。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: point spacingL=20 m and differential settlementΔs=0.10 m. Formula Δslope=100Δs/L; substitution 100*0.10/20 = 0.5 %. Boundary: Small-deformation geometry, not slope stability or foundation capacity analysis.
steps.failure: 基準點也沉陷會使全部測點看似不動。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A settling datum can make all monitored points appear stationary. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 設置穩定外部基準點，重複測量並查局部裂縫與積水。在離線場景為「不均勻沉陷巡測」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Use a stable external datum, repeat surveys and inspect cracks and ponding. Build an offline evidence table for differential-settlement survey; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 滲出水輸送能源：提升水頭與電力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Leachate-conveyance energy: Lift head and electrical power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 滲出水輸送能源：提升水頭與電力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Leachate-conveyance energy: Lift head and electrical power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「滲出水輸送能源」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at leachate-conveyance energy.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
steps.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「滲出水輸送能源」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for leachate-conveyance energy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「長期控制設備備援」觀察此因果關係。

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：P=100、R=30、ET=40、ΔS=10 mm，同一期間。公式 Perc=P-R-ET-ΔS；代入 100-30-40-10 = 20 mm。適用邊界：面積平均帳，未表示襯層缺陷造成的局部滲漏。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: P=100, R=30, ET=40 andΔS=10 mm over the same period. Formula Perc=P-R-ET-ΔS; substitution 100-30-40-10 = 20 mm. Boundary: Area-average ledger; localized leakage through liner defects is not represented.

title: 德國埃姆舍河整治
summary: 埃姆舍轉型先把污水從河道移入管網與處理系統，再改善河岸與棲地。學徒需檢查污水未分離時，單做景觀能否持續維持水質。
summaryEn: The Emscher transformation moves sewage from the river into sewers and treatment before restoring banks and habitat. Learners assess whether landscaping alone can sustain water quality without sewage separation.

steps.title: 污水與雨水來源分類：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sewage/stormwater source separation: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污水與雨水來源分類：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sewage/stormwater source separation: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「污水與雨水來源分類」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at sewage/stormwater source separation.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「污水與雨水來源分類」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for sewage/stormwater source separation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: Manning 模型以水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度表示明渠平均輸送能力；加粗表面會降低同水位的流量。本單元在「河道與幹管不同邊界」觀察此因果關係。

steps.objective: 辨識 低地提升系統：提升水頭與電力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「低地提升系統」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at lowland lift system.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。

steps.objective: 辨識 處理廠與河道質量帳：去除效率與質量去向 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Treatment/river mass ledger: Removal efficiency and mass destination and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 去除是污染物由水相移到污泥或被轉化；以相同流量比較濃度可估效率，但不能省略副產物流。本單元在「處理廠與河道質量帳」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Removal moves pollutants from water to solids or transforms them; concentration comparison estimates efficiency at equal flows but does not eliminate residual streams. Examine this relationship at treatment/river mass ledger.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Cin=200 mg/L、Cout=40 mg/L且進出水量相同。公式 η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin；代入 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %。適用邊界：只適用同一物種、同時窗且等流量；不能代替總污染收支。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Cin=200 mg/L and Cout=40 mg/L at equal inlet and outlet flows. steps.instruction: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「雨天面源逕流」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at wet-weather diffuse runoff.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。

steps.objective: 辨識 恢復河岸沖蝕：河床剪應力與岸坡材料 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Restored-bank shear: Bed shear and bank materials and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 均勻流平均剪應力約為ρgRS；植被與岸坡材料的抗蝕能力應與局部流況一起檢核。本單元在「恢復河岸沖蝕」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Mean boundary shear in uniform flow is aboutρgRS; erosion resistance of vegetation and banks needs checking against local hydraulics. Examine this relationship at restored-bank shear.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：ρ=1000 kg/m³、R=0.6 m、S=0.001。公式 τ=ρgRS；代入 1000*9.81*0.6*0.001 = 5.886 Pa。適用邊界：斷面平均值，不含彎道、橋墩與局部湍流尖峰。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: ρ=1000 kg/m³, R=0.6 m andS=0.001. Formula τ=ρgRS; substitution 1000*9.81*0.6*0.001 = 5.886 Pa. Boundary: Section mean; bends, piers and local turbulence peaks excluded.
steps.failure: 彎道外側局部沖刷可遠高於平均值。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Outer-bend local scour can greatly exceed the mean. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 比較洪後沖淤剖面與植被存活，不只採用一張乾季照片。在離線場景為「恢復河岸沖蝕」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare post-flood erosion profiles and plant survival rather than one dry-season photograph. Build an offline evidence table for restored-bank shear; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instructionEn: Green area differs from connected usable habitat; hard barriers, lighting and maintenance affect movement. Examine this relationship at river-corridor linkage.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.

title: 鹿特丹 Benthemplein 水廣場
summary: Benthemplein把城市活動空間兼作暴雨調蓄。學徒由屋頂集水走到入口、分池、出流與乾天恢復，辨認容量足夠但入口堵塞或下游頂托的失敗情境。
summaryEn: Benthemplein combines civic activity with storm storage. Follow roof catchments, inlets, basins, outlets and recovery, identifying failure despite sufficient volume when inlets block or downstream backwater occurs.

stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 屋頂與鋪面集水：集水面積與逕流量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Roof/pavement catchment: Catchment area and runoff volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 屋頂與鋪面集水：集水面積與逕流量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Roof/pavement catchment: Catchment area and runoff volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「屋頂與鋪面集水」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at roof/pavement catchment.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
steps.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「屋頂與鋪面集水」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for roof/pavement catchment; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.textEn: Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at roof/pavement catchment.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「屋頂與鋪面集水」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the roof/pavement catchment measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

steps.title: 入口攔污與旁通：入口截留與旁通體積：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Inlet debris and bypass: Inlet capture and bypass volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 入口攔污與旁通：入口截留與旁通體積 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Inlet debris and bypass: Inlet capture and bypass volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 地表逕流不一定全進入儲水空間；入口攔污、坡向與旁通共同決定實際捕獲量，缺少入口維護會使容積閒置仍淹水。本單元在「入口攔污與旁通」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Surface runoff does not all enter storage; inlet debris, slope and bypass determine capture, so neglected inlets can cause flooding while storage remains empty. Examine this relationship at inlet debris and bypass.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：入流事件300 m³、假設捕獲比例0.85。公式 Vbypass=Vin(1-fcapture)；代入 300*(1-0.85) = 45 m³。適用邊界：捕獲比例為事件平均假設；實際值需依水深、入口形狀和堵塞校準。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: event inflow300 m³ and assumed capture fraction0.85. Formula Vbypass=Vin(1-fcapture); substitution 300*(1-0.85) = 45 m³. Boundary: Event-average capture is assumed; actual values require depth-, geometry- and blockage-dependent calibration.
steps.failure: 只擴大池體卻不處理入口阻塞無法提高捕獲；先查流路。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Enlarging storage without clearing a blocked inlet does not improve capture; inspect the route first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 比較上游逕流、入口與旁通流，雨後記錄攔污覆蓋率及清理前後差異。在離線場景為「入口攔污與旁通」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare upstream runoff, inlet capture and bypass; document debris coverage and pre/post-cleaning differences. Build an offline evidence table for inlet debris and bypass; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.textEn: Surface runoff does not all enter storage; inlet debris, slope and bypass determine capture, so neglected inlets can cause flooding while storage remains empty. Examine this relationship at inlet debris and bypass.

steps.title: 地表導水溝：流速與通水斷面：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Surface conveyance gutter: Velocity and flow area: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 地表導水溝：流速與通水斷面 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Surface conveyance gutter: Velocity and flow area and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 連續方程 Q=Av 將流量連到平均流速；局部收縮與阻塞提高流速及水頭損失。本單元在「地表導水溝」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Continuity Q=Av links discharge to mean velocity; local contraction and blockage increase velocity and head loss. Examine this relationship at surface conveyance gutter.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：流量 Q=0.9 m³/s、有效面積 A=0.6 m²。公式 v=Q/A；代入 0.9/0.6 = 1.5 m/s。適用邊界：均勻平均流；不能用平均流速判定局部沖刷或人員安全。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: flow Q=0.9 m³/s and clear area A=0.6 m². Formula v=Q/A; substitution 0.9/0.6 = 1.5 m/s. Boundary: Uniform mean flow; local scour or human safety cannot be inferred from mean velocity alone.
steps.failure: 只使用名目斷面會忽略攔污物或沉積造成的縮減。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Nominal area misses reductions caused by debris or sediment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 比較水位、流量與有效面積，再以斷面多點量測查偏流。在離線場景為「地表導水溝」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare level, flow and clear area, then inspect nonuniformity with multiple section measurements. Build an offline evidence table for surface conveyance gutter; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：總容積500 m³、已有水120 m³、不可用容積30 m³。公式 Vavailable=Vgross-Vexisting-Vunusable；代入 500-120-30 = 350 m³。適用邊界：單一時間點幾何帳；不能取代事件水力或溢流路徑分析。

Compare with baseline 350 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

stages.title: 設備操作與量測
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 暴雨分池水量帳：調蓄與連續方程：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Storm basin-routing ledger: Storage and continuity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 暴雨分池水量帳：調蓄與連續方程 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Storm basin-routing ledger: Storage and continuity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 調蓄量隨入流減出流累積；容積夠大仍須確認退水能力，否則下一場雨開始時未必為空。本單元在「暴雨分池水量帳」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Storage accumulates inflow minus outflow; sufficient geometric volume is not enough if drawdown leaves it occupied before the next storm. Examine this relationship at storm basin-routing ledger.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：一小時內 Qin=2.0 m³/s、Qout=0.6 m³/s。公式 ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt；代入 (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³。適用邊界：矩形單一歷線且無滲漏；真實設計必須積分完整降雨歷線。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: over one hour Qin=2.0 m³/s and Qout=0.6 m³/s. Formula ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt; substitution (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³. Boundary: One rectangular hydrograph without leakage; real design must integrate the full event hydrograph.
steps.failure: 水位計零點漂移會看似增加儲量，需獨立水尺確認。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Level-sensor zero drift can mimic storage gain; confirm with an independent staff gauge. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 以五分鐘資料逐步積分，再與水位—容積曲線核對。在離線場景為「暴雨分池水量帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Integrate five-minute data and compare with the stage-storage curve. Build an offline evidence table for storm basin-routing ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 孔口與尾水條件：出流孔口與水頭變化：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Outlet and tailwater conditions: Outlet orifice and changing head: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 孔口與尾水條件：出流孔口與水頭變化 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Outlet and tailwater conditions: Outlet orifice and changing head and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 孔口流量近似與水頭平方根成正比，因此退水末期會變慢；固定流量估算只能是另有控制時的簡化。本單元在「孔口與尾水條件」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Orifice flow is approximately proportional to the square root of head, so late drawdown slows; constant discharge is a simplification requiring separate control. Examine this relationship at outlet and tailwater conditions.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：流量係數Cd=0.62、孔口面積0.02 m²、孔心水頭h=0.5 m。公式 Q=Cd A sqrt(2gh)；代入 0.62*0.02*(2*9.81*0.5)**0.5 = 0.03883794 m³/s。適用邊界：自由出流、穩態近似、無尾水淹沒或堵塞；係數為教學假定。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Cd=0.62, outlet area0.02 m² and head above outlet center h=0.5 m. Formula Q=Cd A sqrt(2gh); substitution 0.62*0.02*(2*9.81*0.5)**0.5 = 0.03883794 m³/s. Boundary: Quasi-steady free discharge without submergence or blockage; the coefficient is hypothetical.
steps.failure: 下游管網頂托時自由出流式不再適用；切換淹沒邊界並保留溢流路徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Sewer backwater invalidates free discharge; use a submerged boundary and retain overflow routing. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 量測上游水位與下游尾水，再以容積變化核對流量。在離線場景為「孔口與尾水條件」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure upstream level and tailwater, then verify discharge from volume change. Build an offline evidence table for outlet and tailwater conditions; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction:

steps.title: 雨後公共使用恢復：退水時間與恢復使用：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Post-storm public-use recovery: Drawdown time and return to use: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 雨後公共使用恢復：退水時間與恢復使用 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Post-storm public-use recovery: Drawdown time and return to use and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 暫存水需在下次事件前排空並確認使用條件；退水時間由可用排水流量決定。本單元在「雨後公共使用恢復」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Stored water needs drawdown before the next event and a check before public use; available discharge governs drawdown time. Examine this relationship at post-storm public-use recovery.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：待排水V=180 m³、定流量Q=15 m³/h。公式 t=V/Q；代入 180/15 = 12 h。適用邊界：固定出流示範；孔口出流隨水頭下降須積分計算。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: stored waterV=180 m³ and constant dischargeQ=15 m³/h. Formula t=V/Q; substitution 180/15 = 12 h. Boundary: Constant-flow illustration; orifice discharge declining with head needs integration.
steps.failure: 出水口被落葉堵塞會延長不可用時間。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Leaf-blocked outlets lengthen unavailable time. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 以水位記錄核對退水曲線，巡查積水與污物後才恢復場地。在離線場景為「雨後公共使用恢復」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Check the drawdown curve against level data and inspect standing water and debris before reopening. Build an offline evidence table for post-storm public-use recovery; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 導水溝沉積粗糙度：重力輸送與粗糙度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Gutter sediment roughness: Gravity conveyance and roughness: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 導水溝沉積粗糙度：重力輸送與粗糙度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Gutter sediment roughness: Gravity conveyance and roughness and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: Manning 模型以水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度表示明渠平均輸送能力；加粗表面會降低同水位的流量。本單元在「導水溝沉積粗糙度」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: The Manning model relates open-channel capacity to hydraulic radius, slope and roughness; greater roughness reduces discharge at the same depth. Examine this relationship at gutter sediment roughness.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：A=4 m²、R=0.8 m、S=0.001、n=0.015。公式 Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2)；代入 (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s。適用邊界：穩定均勻明渠近似；滿管壓力、回水與跌水需另建模。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: A=4 m², R=0.8 m, S=0.001 and n=0.015. Formula Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2); substitution (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s. Boundary: Steady uniform open-channel approximation; pressure flow, backwater and drops require separate models.
steps.failure: 沉積與生物膜改變粗糙度，沿用初建值可能高估能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Sediment and biofilm alter roughness; an as-built value may overestimate capacity. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 量測縱坡與斷面，校準不同水位的流量曲線。在離線場景為「導水溝沉積粗糙度」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure slope and section and calibrate the discharge curve at several depths. Build an offline evidence table for gutter sediment roughness; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.textEn: Select the flood improvement and nearby control measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only control-after to27 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute -1 indicator unit. Compare with baseline -2 indicator unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
前後改變全都必定由這一項工程造成。
optionsEn: Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Every before-after change must be caused by this project.
quiz.explanation: 處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。 採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「淹水改善與鄰近對照」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
quiz.explanationEn: Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for flood improvement and nearby control; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

environmentExample.description: 單元10基準：淹水改善與鄰近對照~Unit10 baseline: flood improvement and nearby control

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.

title: 活性污泥曝氣槽設計
summary: 在虛擬實驗室設計活性污泥水線，依序確定進料、容積、生物量、排泥、需氧與沉澱介面。使用簡化模型比較方案，所有數字均非任何實廠設定。
summaryEn: Design an activated-sludge liquid line in a virtual laboratory: establish feed, volume, biomass, wasting, oxygen and clarification interfaces. Compare options with simplified models; no number is an actual plant setting.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。

steps.title: 設計日進料邊界：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Design-day influent boundary: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 設計日進料邊界：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Design-day influent boundary: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「設計日進料邊界」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at design-day influent boundary.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「設計日進料邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for design-day influent boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: 名目停留時間 V/Q 是容積周轉時間；短流與死區會使實際停留時間分布偏離此平均值。本單元在「曝氣槽有效容積」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal retention V/Q is a volume turnover time; short-circuiting and dead zones distort the actual residence-time distribution. Examine this relationship at aeration-basin active volume.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有效容積 V=800 m³、流量 Q=2400 m³/d。公式 t=24V/Q；代入 24*800/2400 = 8 h。適用邊界：有效容積不含不可用空間；不代表所有水團均停留同樣久。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: effective volume V=800 m³ and flow Q=2400 m³/d. Formula t=24V/Q; substitution 24*800/2400 = 8 h. Boundary: Effective volume excludes unusable space; not every parcel remains for the same duration.
steps.failure: 隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「曝氣槽有效容積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。

steps.title: 有機負荷與微生物庫存：食微比與生物量庫存：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Organic food/biomass inventory: Food-to-microorganism ratio and inventory: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 有機負荷與微生物庫存：食微比與生物量庫存 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Organic food/biomass inventory: Food-to-microorganism ratio and inventory and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 食微比比較每天有機負荷與池內生物固體庫存；BOD、COD、MLSS與MLVSS的基準不得混用。本單元在「有機負荷與微生物庫存」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: F/M compares daily organic load with biomass inventory; BOD, COD, MLSS and MLVSS bases must not be mixed. Examine this relationship at organic food/biomass inventory.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=2000 m³/d、BOD=0.20 kg/m³、V=1000 m³、MLVSS=2 kg/m³。公式 F/M=QS/(VX)；代入 2000*0.20/(1000*2) = 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。適用邊界：完全混合名目比值，未包含不可生物分解分率與溫度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=2000 m³/d, BOD=0.20 kg/m³, V=1000 m³ and MLVSS=2 kg/m³. Formula F/M=QS/(VX); substitution 2000*0.20/(1000*2) = 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Boundary: Nominal completely mixed ratio; nonbiodegradable fractions and temperature are excluded.
steps.failure: 把惰性固體當活性生物量，會低估真正食微比。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Counting inert solids as active biomass understates the true F/M. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 分別量測流量、可生化基質與揮發性固體，再追蹤出水趨勢。在離線場景為「有機負荷與微生物庫存」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure flow, biodegradable substrate and volatile solids separately and track effluent trends. Build an offline evidence table for organic food/biomass inventory; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 排泥與固體年齡：污泥齡與固體流失：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Wasting and solids age: Sludge age and solids losses: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 排泥與固體年齡：污泥齡與固體流失 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Wasting and solids age: Sludge age and solids losses and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污泥齡等於系統固體庫存除以每天排出的固體；出水帶泥也必須列入，不只剩餘污泥。本單元在「排泥與固體年齡」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: SRT equals system solids inventory divided by daily solids losses; effluent carryover counts as well as wasting. Examine this relationship at wasting and solids age.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：庫存6000 kg、剩餘污泥400 kg/d、出水固體100 kg/d。公式 SRT=M/(W+E)；代入 6000/(400+100) = 12 d。適用邊界：準穩態且計算邊界一致；忽略日內庫存變化。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: inventory6000 kg, wasted solids400 kg/d and effluent solids100 kg/d. Formula SRT=M/(W+E); substitution 6000/(400+100) = 12 d. Boundary: Quasi-steady inventory with consistent boundaries; intraday inventory changes are neglected.
steps.failure: 二沉池帶泥會降低污泥齡，不能只調排泥閥猜測。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Clarifier carryover lowers SRT and cannot be diagnosed by wasting settings alone. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 以排泥流量乘固體濃度，並同步估出水SS負荷。在離線場景為「排泥與固體年齡」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Multiply wasting flow by solids concentration and estimate concurrent effluent SS load. Build an offline evidence table for wasting and solids age; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
