steps.title: 鼓風需氧與現場效率：氧轉移與曝氣功率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Oxygen and field-transfer efficiency: Oxygen transfer and aeration power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 鼓風需氧與現場效率：氧轉移與曝氣功率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Oxygen and field-transfer efficiency: Oxygen transfer and aeration power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氧需求與設備供氧能力須用相同工況基準；清水標準效率不能直接當污水池中的效率。本單元在「鼓風需氧與現場效率」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Oxygen demand and equipment transfer capacity require the same conditions; clean-water standard efficiency is not wastewater performance. Examine this relationship at oxygen and field-transfer efficiency.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想需氧量480 kg O₂/d、現場修正供氧效率1.5 kg O₂/kWh。公式 Pavg=O2/(24 Efield)；代入 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW。適用邊界：平均功率示範，未含尖峰、混合需求或備援餘度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical oxygen demand480 kg O₂/d and field-corrected efficiency1.5 kg O₂/kWh. Formula Pavg=O2/(24 Efield); substitution 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW. Boundary: Average-power illustration; peaks, mixing requirements and reserve margin are excluded.
steps.failure: 散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「鼓風需氧與現場效率」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for oxygen and field-transfer efficiency; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
把風量加倍必定使有效供氧加倍。
散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Doubling airflow necessarily doubles useful oxygen transfer.

quiz.explanationEn: Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Build an offline evidence table for oxygen and field-transfer efficiency; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.titleEn: Additional nitrification oxygen: Oxygen balance for nitrification: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 硝化額外需氧：硝化的氧需求收支 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 氨氮氧化成硝酸鹽消耗氧；以氮質量為基準的化學計量與有機碳需氧量應分別列出。本單元在「硝化額外需氧」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Oxidizing ammonia nitrogen to nitrate consumes oxygen; nitrogen-based stoichiometry and carbonaceous oxygen demand must be listed separately. Examine this relationship at additional nitrification oxygen.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想轉化氨氮量N=30 kg N/d、理論係數4.57 kg O₂/kg N。公式 O2=4.57N；代入 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d。適用邊界：理論完全氧化上界計量，未扣細胞合成或考慮動力學。

steps.title: 前置無氧區碳源：反硝化的電子供體需求：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pre-anoxic carbon source: Electron-donor demand for denitrification: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 前置無氧區碳源：反硝化的電子供體需求 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pre-anoxic carbon source: Electron-donor demand for denitrification and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 硝酸鹽還原需要電子供體；理論COD當量僅是起點，可利用碳、細胞產率與溶氧競爭會改變需求。本單元在「前置無氧區碳源」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Nitrate reduction needs an electron donor; theoretical COD equivalence is only a starting point because available carbon, growth and oxygen competition alter demand. Examine this relationship at pre-anoxic carbon source.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Internal recycle and hydraulics: Internal recirculation and hydraulic load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 回流把反應物帶回前段，也增加管線與反應區通過量；回流率不是污染物去除率。本單元在「內回流與水力負荷」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recirculation returns reactants upstream while increasing pipe and zone throughput; recycle ratio is not removal efficiency. Examine this relationship at internal recycle and hydraulics.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進水Q=1000 m³/d、內回流Qr=2000 m³/d。公式 Qzone=Q+Qr；代入 1000+2000 = 3000 m³/d。適用邊界：只計指定區域的循環水力負荷；外部排放仍須另作平衡。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: influentQ=1000 m³/d and internal recycleQr=2000 m³/d. Formula Qzone=Q+Qr; substitution 1000+2000 = 3000 m³/d. Boundary: Hydraulic throughput of one specified zone only; external discharge has a separate balance.
steps.failure: 把回流水加到整廠外部出水會造成假性水量增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Adding recycled flow to external effluent creates fictitious water production. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 在流路圖分開標示內回流與真正出水，避免重複計量。在離線場景為「內回流與水力負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Mark internal recycle separately from final effluent to avoid double counting. Build an offline evidence table for internal recycle and hydraulics; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「二沉池固液分離」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at secondary clarification.

steps.instruction: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「DO、流量與實驗室交叉核對」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at DO/flow/laboratory cross-check.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.

steps.failureEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

steps.checkEn: Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for DO/flow/laboratory cross-check; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

title: 序批式反應槽操作

steps.title: 每批污染質量輸入：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Per-batch pollutant input: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 每批污染質量輸入：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Per-batch pollutant input: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「每批污染質量輸入」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at per-batch pollutant input.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「每批污染質量輸入」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for per-batch pollutant input; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: 調蓄量隨入流減出流累積；容積夠大仍須確認退水能力，否則下一場雨開始時未必為空。本單元在「兩批之間進水緩衝」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Storage accumulates inflow minus outflow; sufficient geometric volume is not enough if drawdown leaves it occupied before the next storm. Examine this relationship at interbatch influent buffer.

steps.title: 雙槽週期與日能力：SBR週期與處理量：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 雙槽週期與日能力：SBR週期與處理量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 序批式反應槽用時間切換充填、反應、沉澱與排水；週期變長會降低每天可完成批次。本單元在「雙槽週期與日能力」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: An SBR separates fill, reaction, settling and decant in time; a longer cycle reduces daily batch capacity. Examine this relationship at two-basin cycles/daily capacity.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：每批排水V=200 m³、週期6 h、槽數2。公式 Qday=V(24/tcycle)N；代入 200*(24/6)*2 = 1600 m³/d。適用邊界：穩定批次理想排程，未含備援停機及進水暫存。

steps.objective: 辨識 反應期有效水量：水力停留時間 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Reaction-period effective volume: Hydraulic retention time and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 名目停留時間 V/Q 是容積周轉時間；短流與死區會使實際停留時間分布偏離此平均值。本單元在「反應期有效水量」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal retention V/Q is a volume turnover time; short-circuiting and dead zones distort the actual residence-time distribution. Examine this relationship at reaction-period effective volume.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有效容積 V=800 m³、流量 Q=2400 m³/d。公式 t=24V/Q；代入 24*800/2400 = 8 h。適用邊界：有效容積不含不可用空間；不代表所有水團均停留同樣久。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: effective volume V=800 m³ and flow Q=2400 m³/d. Formula t=24V/Q; substitution 24*800/2400 = 8 h. Boundary: Effective volume excludes unusable space; not every parcel remains for the same duration.
steps.failure: 隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「反應期有效水量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for reaction-period effective volume; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 曝氣階段供氧：氧轉移與曝氣功率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Aerated-phase oxygen: Oxygen transfer and aeration power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 曝氣階段供氧：氧轉移與曝氣功率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Aerated-phase oxygen: Oxygen transfer and aeration power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氧需求與設備供氧能力須用相同工況基準；清水標準效率不能直接當污水池中的效率。本單元在「曝氣階段供氧」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Oxygen demand and equipment transfer capacity require the same conditions; clean-water standard efficiency is not wastewater performance. Examine this relationship at aerated-phase oxygen.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想需氧量480 kg O₂/d、現場修正供氧效率1.5 kg O₂/kWh。公式 Pavg=O2/(24 Efield)；代入 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW。適用邊界：平均功率示範，未含尖峰、混合需求或備援餘度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical oxygen demand480 kg O₂/d and field-corrected efficiency1.5 kg O₂/kWh. Formula Pavg=O2/(24 Efield); substitution 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW. Boundary: Average-power illustration; peaks, mixing requirements and reserve margin are excluded.
steps.failure: 散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「曝氣階段供氧」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for aerated-phase oxygen; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 氨轉化與週期終點：硝化的氧需求收支：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Ammonia conversion/cycle endpoint: Oxygen balance for nitrification: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 氨轉化與週期終點：硝化的氧需求收支 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Ammonia conversion/cycle endpoint: Oxygen balance for nitrification and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氨氮氧化成硝酸鹽消耗氧；以氮質量為基準的化學計量與有機碳需氧量應分別列出。本單元在「氨轉化與週期終點」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Oxidizing ammonia nitrogen to nitrate consumes oxygen; nitrogen-based stoichiometry and carbonaceous oxygen demand must be listed separately. Examine this relationship at ammonia conversion/cycle endpoint.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想轉化氨氮量N=30 kg N/d、理論係數4.57 kg O₂/kg N。公式 O2=4.57N；代入 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d。適用邊界：理論完全氧化上界計量，未扣細胞合成或考慮動力學。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical ammonia conversionN=30 kg N/d and theoretical factor4.57 kg O₂/kg N. Formula O2=4.57N; substitution 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d. Boundary: Theoretical complete-oxidation stoichiometry; biomass assimilation and kinetics are omitted.
steps.failure: 低溫或抑制物可使氨突破，即使供氧功率正常。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Cold conditions or inhibitors can cause ammonia breakthrough despite normal aeration power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用氨、亞硝酸與硝酸三者的氮收支核對，不只看溶氧。在離線場景為「氨轉化與週期終點」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Check a nitrogen balance using ammonia, nitrite and nitrate rather than DO alone. Build an offline evidence table for ammonia conversion/cycle endpoint; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 缺氧階段電子供體：反硝化的電子供體需求：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Anoxic-phase donor: Electron-donor demand for denitrification: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 缺氧階段電子供體：反硝化的電子供體需求 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Anoxic-phase donor: Electron-donor demand for denitrification and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 硝酸鹽還原需要電子供體；理論COD當量僅是起點，可利用碳、細胞產率與溶氧競爭會改變需求。本單元在「缺氧階段電子供體」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Nitrate reduction needs an electron donor; theoretical COD equivalence is only a starting point because available carbon, growth and oxygen competition alter demand. Examine this relationship at anoxic-phase donor.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：待還原硝酸氮20 kg N/d、理論COD當量2.86 kg/kg N。公式 CODmin=2.86N；代入 2.86*20 = 57.2 kg COD/d。適用邊界：理論電子當量示範，不能當現場加藥劑量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: nitrate nitrogen20 kg N/d and theoretical COD equivalence2.86 kg/kg N. Formula CODmin=2.86N; substitution 2.86*20 = 57.2 kg COD/d. Boundary: Theoretical electron-equivalent illustration; not a field chemical dose.
steps.failure: 回流氧先消耗基質，會讓只按硝酸鹽估碳量的模型偏低。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Returned oxygen consumes substrate and makes a nitrate-only carbon estimate too low. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同時看硝酸鹽、可利用COD與溶氧，檢查回流帶氧。在離線場景為「缺氧階段電子供體」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Observe nitrate, available COD and DO together and inspect oxygen introduced by recirculation. Build an offline evidence table for anoxic-phase donor; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 沉澱後排水介面：排水器下降速度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Post-settling decant interface: Decanter lowering rate: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 沉澱後排水介面：排水器下降速度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Post-settling decant interface: Decanter lowering rate and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 排水降低液面；排水速率與水面面積決定下降速度，須與污泥層間距一起觀察。本單元在「沉澱後排水介面」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Decanting lowers the surface; flow and surface area set its lowering rate, which must be observed with clearance above the sludge blanket. Examine this relationship at post-settling decant interface.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：排水Q=120 m³/h、表面積A=200 m²。公式 vlevel=Q/A；代入 120/200 = 0.6 m/h。適用邊界：均勻水面與定截面近似，非排水器型號允許值。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: decantQ=120 m³/h and surface areaA=200 m². Formula vlevel=Q/A; substitution 120/200 = 0.6 m/h. Boundary: Uniform surface and constant-section approximation, not a decanter product limit.
steps.failure: 泥層上浮或液位感測錯誤可使排水器吸入污泥。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Rising sludge or level-sensor error can make a decanter entrain solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 重播液位與泥層高度，檢查排水末段濁度。在離線場景為「沉澱後排水介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Replay liquid and blanket levels and inspect late-decant turbidity. Build an offline evidence table for post-settling decant interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 曝氣時間與日耗電：間歇曝氣與有效運轉：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Aeration time/daily energy: Intermittent aeration and duty: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 曝氣時間與日耗電：間歇曝氣與有效運轉 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Aeration time/daily energy: Intermittent aeration and duty and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 每週期曝氣時間決定每日運轉時數；同平均能耗可能對應不同峰值供氧能力。本單元在「曝氣時間與日耗電」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Aeration time per cycle sets daily operating hours; equal average energy can conceal different peak transfer capacity. Examine this relationship at aeration time/daily energy.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：曝氣器功率20 kW、每天曝氣12 h。公式 E=P ton；代入 20*12 = 240 kWh/d。適用邊界：固定輸入功率示範，不等於氧需求或曝氣策略最佳化。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: aerator power20 kW and12 aerated hours per day. Formula E=P ton; substitution 20*12 = 240 kWh/d. Boundary: Fixed-input-power example, not oxygen demand or optimized control.

steps.failureEn: Accidental aeration during settling disrupts separation as well as wasting energy. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 在週期圖分開記錄曝氣、攪拌、沉澱的電表與狀態。在離線場景為「曝氣時間與日耗電」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Log power and states separately for aeration, mixing and settling on the cycle timeline. Build an offline evidence table for aeration time/daily energy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 跨批次排泥與菌齡：污泥齡與固體流失 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Cross-cycle wasting/solids age: Sludge age and solids losses and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污泥齡等於系統固體庫存除以每天排出的固體；出水帶泥也必須列入，不只剩餘污泥。本單元在「跨批次排泥與菌齡」觀察此因果關係。

steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：庫存6000 kg、剩餘污泥400 kg/d、出水固體100 kg/d。公式 SRT=M/(W+E)；代入 6000/(400+100) = 12 d。適用邊界：準穩態且計算邊界一致；忽略日內庫存變化。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: inventory6000 kg, wasted solids400 kg/d and effluent solids100 kg/d. scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. steps.title: 預處理後進料品質：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Post-pretreatment feed quality: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 預處理後進料品質：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Post-pretreatment feed quality: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「預處理後進料品質」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at post-pretreatment feed quality.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「預處理後進料品質」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for post-pretreatment feed quality; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.titleEn: High-biomass loading interpretation: Food-to-microorganism ratio and inventory: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 高生物量負荷判讀：食微比與生物量庫存 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of High-biomass loading interpretation: Food-to-microorganism ratio and inventory and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 食微比比較每天有機負荷與池內生物固體庫存；BOD、COD、MLSS與MLVSS的基準不得混用。本單元在「高生物量負荷判讀」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: F/M compares daily organic load with biomass inventory; BOD, COD, MLSS and MLVSS bases must not be mixed. Examine this relationship at high-biomass loading interpretation.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=2000 m³/d、BOD=0.20 kg/m³、V=1000 m³、MLVSS=2 kg/m³。公式 F/M=QS/(VX)；代入 2000*0.20/(1000*2) = 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。適用邊界：完全混合名目比值，未包含不可生物分解分率與溫度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=2000 m³/d, BOD=0.20 kg/m³, V=1000 m³ and MLVSS=2 kg/m³. Formula F/M=QS/(VX); substitution 2000*0.20/(1000*2) = 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Boundary: Nominal completely mixed ratio; nonbiodegradable fractions and temperature are excluded.

steps.check: 分別量測流量、可生化基質與揮發性固體，再追蹤出水趨勢。在離線場景為「高生物量負荷判讀」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure flow, biodegradable substrate and volatile solids separately and track effluent trends. Build an offline evidence table for high-biomass loading interpretation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 污泥齡及排泥：污泥齡與固體流失：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Solids age and wasting: Sludge age and solids losses: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污泥齡及排泥：污泥齡與固體流失 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Solids age and wasting: Sludge age and solids losses and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污泥齡等於系統固體庫存除以每天排出的固體；出水帶泥也必須列入，不只剩餘污泥。本單元在「污泥齡及排泥」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: SRT equals system solids inventory divided by daily solids losses; effluent carryover counts as well as wasting. Examine this relationship at solids age and wasting.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：庫存6000 kg、剩餘污泥400 kg/d、出水固體100 kg/d。公式 SRT=M/(W+E)；代入 6000/(400+100) = 12 d。適用邊界：準穩態且計算邊界一致；忽略日內庫存變化。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: inventory6000 kg, wasted solids400 kg/d and effluent solids100 kg/d. Formula SRT=M/(W+E); substitution 6000/(400+100) = 12 d. Boundary: Quasi-steady inventory with consistent boundaries; intraday inventory changes are neglected.
steps.failure: 二沉池帶泥會降低污泥齡，不能只調排泥閥猜測。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Clarifier carryover lowers SRT and cannot be diagnosed by wasting settings alone. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 以排泥流量乘固體濃度，並同步估出水SS負荷。在離線場景為「污泥齡及排泥」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Multiply wasting flow by solids concentration and estimate concurrent effluent SS load. Build an offline evidence table for solids age and wasting; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.text: 相同溫度下，通量除以跨膜壓差可作為表觀水力透過率；降低代表阻力增加，但未直接指出污染種類。本單元在「跨膜壓差趨勢」觀察此因果關係。
knowledge.textEn: At the same temperature, flux divided by transmembrane pressure gives apparent permeability; a decrease indicates more resistance but not its chemical cause. Examine this relationship at transmembrane-pressure trend.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「跨膜壓差趨勢」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把 TMP升成0.20 bar，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 L/(m²·h·bar)。與基準 200 L/(m²·h·bar)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the transmembrane-pressure trend measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only TMP to0.20 bar with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 L/(m²·h·bar). Compare with baseline 200 L/(m²·h·bar) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 跨膜壓差越大必定代表膜更乾淨。
相同溫度下，通量除以跨膜壓差可作為表觀水力透過率；降低代表阻力增加，但未直接指出污染種類。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
optionsEn: Higher transmembrane pressure always means a cleaner membrane.
At the same temperature, flux divided by transmembrane pressure gives apparent permeability; a decrease indicates more resistance but not its chemical cause.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
quiz.explanation: 相同溫度下，通量除以跨膜壓差可作為表觀水力透過率；降低代表阻力增加，但未直接指出污染種類。 比較相同溫度與流量的前後資料，測壓點須一致。在離線場景為「跨膜壓差趨勢」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
quiz.explanationEn: At the same temperature, flux divided by transmembrane pressure gives apparent permeability; a decrease indicates more resistance but not its chemical cause. Compare before/after data at equal temperature and flow with identical pressure taps. Build an offline evidence table for transmembrane-pressure trend; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳：膜抽吸週期與淨產水：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Backwash/relaxation net-production ledger: Membrane suction cycles and net production: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳：膜抽吸週期與淨產水 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Backwash/relaxation net-production ledger: Membrane suction cycles and net production and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 膜列反洗或鬆弛時不產水，日平均通量低於抽吸期間通量；若還耗用產水反洗，需另扣反洗體積。本單元在「反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Backwash or relaxation interrupts production, so time-averaged flux is lower than suction-period flux; permeate used for backwash must also be deducted. Examine this relationship at backwash/relaxation net-production ledger.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：抽吸通量30 L/(m²·h)、每10分鐘抽吸8分鐘，先忽略反洗耗水。公式 Jnet=Jsuction tsuction/tcycle；代入 30*8/10 = 24 L/(m²·h)。適用邊界：重複穩態週期且抽吸通量固定；不是膜產品的允許週期。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: suction flux30 L/(m²·h),8 minutes suction per10-minute cycle, initially ignoring backwash water. Formula Jnet=Jsuction tsuction/tcycle; substitution 30*8/10 = 24 L/(m²·h). Boundary: Repeated steady cycles and constant suction flux; this is not a permissible product operating cycle.
steps.failure: 用抽吸瞬間通量推算全天產水會高估能力；先重建時間帳。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Extrapolating instantaneous suction flux over the full day overstates capacity; reconstruct the time ledger. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用產水總表核對整日淨產水，並區分反洗回流、排放及停機。在離線場景為「反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Reconcile daily net permeate with a totalizer and distinguish backwash return, disposal and downtime. Build an offline evidence table for backwash/relaxation net-production ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳：膜抽吸週期與淨產水
knowledge.titleEn: Backwash/relaxation net-production ledger: Membrane suction cycles and net production
knowledge.text: 膜列反洗或鬆弛時不產水，日平均通量低於抽吸期間通量；若還耗用產水反洗，需另扣反洗體積。本單元在「反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳」觀察此因果關係。

knowledge.text: 先點選「反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把每10分鐘抽吸時間降為7分鐘，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 21 L/(m²·h)。與基準 24 L/(m²·h)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the backwash/relaxation net-production ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only suction time to7 of every10 minutes with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 21 L/(m²·h). Compare with baseline 24 L/(m²·h) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 膜列反洗或鬆弛時不產水，日平均通量低於抽吸期間通量；若還耗用產水反洗，需另扣反洗體積。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
膜停止抽吸時仍可用相同通量計入產水。
optionsEn: Backwash or relaxation interrupts production, so time-averaged flux is lower than suction-period flux; permeate used for backwash must also be deducted.

steps.instruction: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「水質與壓差感測校驗」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at quality/pressure instrument checks.

steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.

steps.objective: 辨識 離線清洗期間可用能力：備援與共同失效 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Capacity during offline cleaning: Redundancy and common failures and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「離線清洗期間可用能力」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Parallel redundancy reduces outages from independent failures, but common power, feed or controllers invalidate independence. Examine this relationship at capacity during offline cleaning.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.
steps.failure: 兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「離線清洗期間可用能力」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for capacity during offline cleaning; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.

title: 移動床生物膜反應器
summary: MBBR以移動載體提供附著生物膜表面，水流、載體混合與供氧共同影響反應。學徒區分名目填充比例、受保護面積、實際活性與攔網通水。
summaryEn: MBBR uses moving carriers for attached biofilm; flow, carrier mixing and oxygen jointly affect reaction. Distinguish fill fraction, protected area, actual activity and retaining-screen hydraulics.

steps.title: 可生物降解進料：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Biodegradable feed: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 可生物降解進料：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Biodegradable feed: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「可生物降解進料」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at biodegradable feed.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「可生物降解進料」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for biodegradable feed; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 載體受保護面積：載體保護面積與填充率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Protected carrier area: Carrier protected area and fill fraction: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 載體受保護面積：載體保護面積與填充率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Protected carrier area: Carrier protected area and fill fraction and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: MBBR有效面積由反應槽容積、載體填充率及載體保護比表面積相乘；不能把槽壁面積當生物膜面積。本單元在「載體受保護面積」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: MBBR area is reactor volume times carrier fill and protected specific area; reactor-wall area is not the biofilm area. Examine this relationship at protected carrier area.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：槽容V=100 m³、填充f=0.50、載體保護面積a=400 m²/m³載體。公式 A=Vfa；代入 100*0.50*400 = 20000 m²。適用邊界：假想幾何值，實際可用生物面積仍受堵塞與膜厚影響。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reactorV=100 m³, fillf=0.50 and protected areaa=400 m²/m³ carrier. Formula A=Vfa; substitution 100*0.50*400 = 20000 m². Boundary: Hypothetical geometry; usable biological area also depends on clogging and film thickness.
steps.failure: 過高填充可能降低混合並增加攔網負擔。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Excess fill can reduce mixing and overload retention screens. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 依載體資料確認面積定義，盤點裝填量並觀察是否均勻翻動。在離線場景為「載體受保護面積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Check the area definition in carrier data, inventory media and observe uniform movement. Build an offline evidence table for protected carrier area; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 單位附著面積負荷：生物膜表面負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Attached-area loading: Biofilm surface loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 單位附著面積負荷：生物膜表面負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Attached-area loading: Biofilm surface loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 附著生長系統以每天負荷除以可用面積評估負擔；有機物與氨氮必須分開計算。本單元在「單位附著面積負荷」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Attached-growth loading is daily load divided by usable area; organic matter and ammonia must be accounted for separately. Examine this relationship at attached-area loading.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有機負荷60 kg/d、可用生物面積20000 m²。公式 LA=1000L/A；代入 1000*60/20000 = 3 g/(m²·d)。適用邊界：假想平均表面負荷，未計溫度、氧限制與生物膜動力學。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: organic load60 kg/d and usable biological area20000 m². Formula LA=1000L/A; substitution 1000*60/20000 = 3 g/(m²·d). Boundary: Hypothetical mean surface load; temperature, oxygen limitation and kinetics excluded.
steps.failure: 外層異營菌搶氧可使同面積硝化能力下降。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Outer heterotrophs can consume oxygen and reduce nitrification at the same area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 量測進出水負荷並將其與載體面積和水溫一起報告。在離線場景為「單位附著面積負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure influent/effluent loads and report them alongside carrier area and water temperature. Build an offline evidence table for attached-area loading; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 膜厚與傳質路徑：生物膜擴散距離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Film thickness/transport path: Biofilm diffusion length: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 膜厚與傳質路徑：生物膜擴散距離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Film thickness/transport path: Biofilm diffusion length and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 擴散特徵時間與膜厚平方成正比；生物膜加厚會增加質傳時間，不必然增加有效反應量。本單元在「膜厚與傳質路徑」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Characteristic diffusion time scales with thickness squared; a thicker film lengthens transport and need not increase effective reaction. Examine this relationship at film thickness/transport path.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：膜厚L=0.0005 m、有效擴散係數D=1e-9 m²/s。公式 tdiff=L²/D；代入 0.0005**2/1e-9 = 250 s。適用邊界：無反應的量級估計；反應—擴散與孔隙結構需更完整模型。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: film thicknessL=0.0005 m and effective diffusivityD=1e-9 m²/s. Formula tdiff=L²/D; substitution 0.0005**2/1e-9 = 250 s. Boundary: Nonreactive timescale estimate; reaction-diffusion and porosity need a fuller model.
steps.failure: 厚膜內層缺氧與脫落會讓出水SS升高。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Oxygen-poor thick inner layers and sloughing can raise effluent SS. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 比較膜厚、溶氧剖面與表面負荷，不能僅稱量載體。在離線場景為「膜厚與傳質路徑」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare thickness, oxygen profiles and surface loading rather than carrier mass alone. Build an offline evidence table for film thickness/transport path; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 辨識 混合與需氧分辨：氧轉移與曝氣功率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mixing/oxygen distinction: Oxygen transfer and aeration power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氧需求與設備供氧能力須用相同工況基準；清水標準效率不能直接當污水池中的效率。本單元在「混合與需氧分辨」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Oxygen demand and equipment transfer capacity require the same conditions; clean-water standard efficiency is not wastewater performance. Examine this relationship at mixing/oxygen distinction.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想需氧量480 kg O₂/d、現場修正供氧效率1.5 kg O₂/kWh。公式 Pavg=O2/(24 Efield)；代入 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW。適用邊界：平均功率示範，未含尖峰、混合需求或備援餘度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical oxygen demand480 kg O₂/d and field-corrected efficiency1.5 kg O₂/kWh. Formula Pavg=O2/(24 Efield); substitution 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW. Boundary: Average-power illustration; peaks, mixing requirements and reserve margin are excluded.
steps.failure: 散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「混合與需氧分辨」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for mixing/oxygen distinction; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 載體出口攔網：載體攔網的淨通水面積：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Carrier-retaining outlet screen: Carrier-screen clear flow area: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 載體出口攔網：載體攔網的淨通水面積 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Carrier-retaining outlet screen: Carrier-screen clear flow area and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 攔網需保留載體又讓水通過；開孔率與堵塞決定淨面積，並影響局部水頭損失。本單元在「載體出口攔網」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Retention screens hold media while passing water; open fraction and blockage determine clear area and local head loss. Examine this relationship at carrier-retaining outlet screen.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：總面積2 m²、開孔率0.50、堵塞分率0.20。公式 Aclear=Agross fopen(1-fblocked)；代入 2*0.50*(1-0.20) = 0.8 m²。適用邊界：幾何估計，水頭損失需依網孔及流況另估。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: gross area2 m², open fraction0.50 and blockage fraction0.20. Formula Aclear=Agross fopen(1-fblocked); substitution 2*0.50*(1-0.20) = 0.8 m². Boundary: Geometric estimate; head loss requires aperture and flow information.
steps.failure: 攔網破損會流失載體，堵塞則可能造成溢流。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A damaged screen loses carriers while blockage can cause overflow. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 核對上下游水位與流量，拍攝堵塞範圍並觀察載體流失。在離線場景為「載體出口攔網」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Check upstream/downstream levels and flow, document blockage and observe media loss. Build an offline evidence table for carrier-retaining outlet screen; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 硝化生物膜需氧：硝化的氧需求收支：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Nitrifying-film oxygen: Oxygen balance for nitrification: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 硝化生物膜需氧：硝化的氧需求收支 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Nitrifying-film oxygen: Oxygen balance for nitrification and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氨氮氧化成硝酸鹽消耗氧；以氮質量為基準的化學計量與有機碳需氧量應分別列出。本單元在「硝化生物膜需氧」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Oxidizing ammonia nitrogen to nitrate consumes oxygen; nitrogen-based stoichiometry and carbonaceous oxygen demand must be listed separately. Examine this relationship at nitrifying-film oxygen.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想轉化氨氮量N=30 kg N/d、理論係數4.57 kg O₂/kg N。公式 O2=4.57N；代入 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d。適用邊界：理論完全氧化上界計量，未扣細胞合成或考慮動力學。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical ammonia conversionN=30 kg N/d and theoretical factor4.57 kg O₂/kg N. Formula O2=4.57N; substitution 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d. Boundary: Theoretical complete-oxidation stoichiometry; biomass assimilation and kinetics are omitted.
steps.failure: 低溫或抑制物可使氨突破，即使供氧功率正常。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Cold conditions or inhibitors can cause ammonia breakthrough despite normal aeration power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用氨、亞硝酸與硝酸三者的氮收支核對，不只看溶氧。在離線場景為「硝化生物膜需氧」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Check a nitrogen balance using ammonia, nitrite and nitrate rather than DO alone. Build an offline evidence table for nitrifying-film oxygen; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 水相轉化與脫落固體：去除效率與質量去向：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Conversion/detached solids: Removal efficiency and mass destination: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水相轉化與脫落固體：去除效率與質量去向 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Conversion/detached solids: Removal efficiency and mass destination and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 去除是污染物由水相移到污泥或被轉化；以相同流量比較濃度可估效率，但不能省略副產物流。本單元在「水相轉化與脫落固體」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Removal moves pollutants from water to solids or transforms them; concentration comparison estimates efficiency at equal flows but does not eliminate residual streams. Examine this relationship at conversion/detached solids.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Cin=200 mg/L、Cout=40 mg/L且進出水量相同。公式 η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin；代入 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %。適用邊界：只適用同一物種、同時窗且等流量；不能代替總污染收支。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Cin=200 mg/L and Cout=40 mg/L at equal inlet and outlet flows. Formula η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin; substitution 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %. Boundary: Same species, time window and flow only; not a replacement for a complete pollutant balance.

steps.checkEn: Measure sludge solids and water concentrations together to reconcile removed mass. Build an offline evidence table for conversion/detached solids; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 後段固液分離：表面溢流率與沉降分離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Downstream solids separation: Surface loading and settling separation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 後段固液分離：表面溢流率與沉降分離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Downstream solids separation: Surface loading and settling separation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「後段固液分離」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at downstream solids separation.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。

environmentExample.description: 單元10基準：後段固液分離~Unit10 baseline: downstream solids separation

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.

title: 生物濾池污水處理
summary: 生物濾池讓水流經附著生物膜的介質；布水與通風維持反應，脫落生物膜仍需處理。學徒從預沉走到回流、傳質和終沉，區分過濾與生物轉化。
summaryEn: Trickling filters pass water over attached-film media; distribution and ventilation support reaction while sloughed biomass still needs treatment. Follow primary settling, recycle, transport and final settling, distinguishing filtration from conversion.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 初沉前有機負荷：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Organic load before primary settling: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 初沉前有機負荷：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Organic load before primary settling: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「初沉前有機負荷」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at organic load before primary settling.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

steps.title: 旋轉布水與回流水量：濾床水力負荷與布水：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Rotating distribution/recycle flow: Trickling-filter hydraulic loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 旋轉布水與回流水量：濾床水力負荷與布水 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Rotating distribution/recycle flow: Trickling-filter hydraulic loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 生物濾池需把液體分配到填料表面，回流可改善潤濕但增加水力負荷；過濕會降低通風。本單元在「旋轉布水與回流水量」觀察此因果關係。

steps.instruction: 擴散特徵時間與膜厚平方成正比；生物膜加厚會增加質傳時間，不必然增加有效反應量。本單元在「液膜與生物膜傳質」觀察此因果關係。

steps.instruction: 回流把反應物帶回前段，也增加管線與反應區通過量；回流率不是污染物去除率。本單元在「回流改善濕潤與水力代價」觀察此因果關係。

steps.title: 通風供氧需求：通風氣量與可轉移氧量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Ventilation oxygen demand: Ventilation flow and transferable oxygen: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 通風供氧需求：通風氣量與可轉移氧量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Ventilation oxygen demand: Ventilation flow and transferable oxygen and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 進入濾床的氧氣只有一部分轉移到濕潤生物膜；空氣量足夠不代表分配均勻或氧已到達生物膜深處。本單元在「通風供氧需求」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Only part of the oxygen entering a filter transfers to the wet biofilm; enough air volume does not prove uniform distribution or oxygen penetration. Examine this relationship at ventilation oxygen demand.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：同一參考溫壓下空氣500 m³/h、含氧質量0.28 kg/m³、假設轉移比例0.10。公式 Otransfer=Qair cO2 ftransfer；代入 500*0.28*0.10 = 14 kg O₂/h。適用邊界：教學轉移比例須以實測校正；自然通風隨氣溫與濾床阻力變化，不能保證固定風量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: air500 m³/h at one reference state, oxygen content0.28 kg/m³ and assumed transfer fraction0.10. Formula Otransfer=Qair cO2 ftransfer; substitution 500*0.28*0.10 = 14 kg O₂/h. Boundary: The hypothetical transfer fraction requires measurement; natural ventilation varies with temperature and bed resistance, so airflow is not guaranteed constant.
steps.failure: 積水堵住通氣路徑會限制供氧；先診斷排水與通風阻力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Ponding can obstruct ventilation and limit oxygen; diagnose drainage and airflow resistance first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 比較進出氣氧量與溫壓，觀察排水層、通氣口及濾床含水分布。在離線場景為「通風供氧需求」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare inlet/outlet oxygen on matched pressure/temperature bases and inspect underdrains, vents and bed wetting. Build an offline evidence table for ventilation oxygen demand; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 脫膜污泥與終沉：乾固體與含水率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sloughed sludge/final settling: Dry solids and moisture: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 脫膜污泥與終沉：乾固體與含水率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sloughed sludge/final settling: Dry solids and moisture and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。本單元在「脫膜污泥與終沉」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Wet sludge mass follows dry-solids inventory and solids fraction; dewatering removes water rather than destroying solids. Examine this relationship at sloughed sludge/final settling.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾固體2000 kg/d、固體質量分率0.04。公式 Mwet=MDS/fDS；代入 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d。適用邊界：濃度採質量分率；若體積濃度須先確認密度。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry solids2000 kg/d and solids mass fraction0.04. Formula Mwet=MDS/fDS; substitution 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d. Boundary: Concentration is a mass fraction; volumetric concentration requires density.
steps.failure: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「脫膜污泥與終沉」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for sloughed sludge/final settling; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 區分 布水不均與儀表檢查：感測器偏移校正 的失效原因，提出能排除替代解釋的檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Uneven distribution/instrument checks: Sensor offset calibration with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
steps.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「布水不均與儀表檢查」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for uneven distribution/instrument checks; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.textEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「布水不均與儀表檢查」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the uneven distribution/instrument checks measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

environmentExample.description: 單元10基準：布水不均與儀表檢查~Unit10 baseline: uneven distribution/instrument checks

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.

title: 氧化溝污水處理
summary: 本課以環狀流場、污泥齡與氧需求的協調為主線，從入口負荷盤點、有效環槽容積、固體庫存與活性、食微比與負荷變動進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops coordinating loop flow, sludge age and oxygen demand through ten connected units, beginning with influent loading, effective loop volume, solids inventory and activity, food-to-microorganism ratio. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 入口負荷盤點：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Influent loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 入口負荷盤點 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Influent loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先分離水量尖峰與有機物尖峰，才能判定環槽需要調蓄還是反應容量。
steps.instructionEn: Separate hydraulic peaks from organic peaks before choosing equalization or reaction capacity.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；C=180 mg/L。模型 L=QC/1000，代入得到 360 kg/d。適用邊界：穩定流量與流量加權濃度；瞬時樣本不代表整日。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; C=180 mg/L. Model L=QC/1000 gives 360 kg/d. Applicability: Steady flow and flow-weighted concentration; a grab sample does not represent a day.
steps.failure: 單次低濃度樣本可能漏掉夜間排放。診斷與介入：先回查濃度基準與流量加權採樣，再重算負荷。
steps.failureEn: A low grab sample can miss nighttime discharge. Diagnostic response: First check the concentration basis and flow-weighted sampling, then recalculate loading.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「入口負荷盤點」的觀測點。比對累積流量計與流量比例混合樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for influent loading. Compare the totalizing flowmeter with a flow-proportional composite sample. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 入口負荷盤點

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 C:180→210 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 360 變為 420 kg/d。用「入口負荷盤點」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only C:180→210 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 360 to 420 kg/d. Explain the direction using influent loading, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 食微比與負荷變動：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Food-to-microorganism ratio: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 食微比與負荷變動 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Food-to-microorganism ratio and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把可降解負荷對照生物量，而非只依池容調整進流。
steps.instructionEn: Compare biodegradable load with biomass rather than sizing intake by volume alone.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；S=0.18 kg BOD/m³；V=1500 m³；Xv=2.4 kg MLVSS/m³。模型 F/M=QS/(VXv)，代入得到 0.1 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。適用邊界：單一進流的平均負荷；需另看可生物降解比例與回流負荷。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; S=0.18 kg BOD/m³; V=1500 m³; Xv=2.4 kg MLVSS/m³. Model F/M=QS/(VXv) gives 0.1 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Applicability: Average single-inlet loading; biodegradability and recycle loads require separate assessment.
steps.failure: 只看總 COD 會高估微生物可利用的食物。診斷與介入：核對可利用有機物與揮發固體基準，再比較負荷配置。
steps.failureEn: Total COD can overstate usable substrate. Diagnostic response: Check bioavailable organics and volatile-solids bases before comparing load allocation.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「食微比與負荷變動」的觀測點。核對 BOD 樣本、MLVSS 與生物槽有效體積。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for food-to-microorganism ratio. Check BOD samples, MLVSS and effective biological volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 排泥與污泥齡：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Wasting and sludge age: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 排泥與污泥齡 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Wasting and sludge age and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 排泥控制菌體在系統中的平均停留，回流則重新分配庫存。
steps.instructionEn: Wasting controls average biomass residence; recycle redistributes the inventory.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：固體庫存 MX=4500 kg；排泥=180 kg/d；出流水固體=20 kg/d。模型 SRT=MX/(W+E)，代入得到 22.5 d。適用邊界：全系統固體收支的準穩態估計；回流不是離開系統的排泥。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Solids inventory MX=4500 kg; wasting=180 kg/d; effluent solids=20 kg/d. Model SRT=MX/(W+E) gives 22.5 d. Applicability: Quasi-steady whole-system solids balance; return sludge is not a solids exit.
steps.failure: 把回流量算成排泥會得到錯誤污泥齡。診斷與介入：用實際排出乾固體修正 SRT，分開回流與離開系統的流股。
steps.failureEn: Counting recycle as wasting gives a false SRT. Diagnostic response: Correct SRT with actual exported dry solids, separating recycle from system exits.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「排泥與污泥齡」的觀測點。從排泥流量、含固率與出流水 TSS 各算質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。

steps.title: 曝氣與溶氧梯度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Aeration and DO gradients: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 曝氣與溶氧梯度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Aeration and DO gradients and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 循環沿程的耗氧與補氧共同形成好氧、低氧區，單點 DO 不能代表全槽。
steps.instructionEn: Oxygen use and supply create aerobic and low-oxygen zones along the loop; one DO point is insufficient.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：kLa=4 h⁻¹；C*=8 mg/L；C=2 mg/L；V=1000 m³。模型 OTR=kLa(C*-C)V/1000，代入得到 24 kg O2/h。適用邊界：等溫、均勻混合的簡化傳質；kLa 已假設為污水條件。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: kLa=4 h⁻¹; C*=8 mg/L; C=2 mg/L; V=1000 m³. Model OTR=kLa(C*-C)V/1000 gives 24 kg O2/h. Applicability: Isothermal mixed-tank transfer; kLa is assumed to represent wastewater conditions.
steps.failure: 探頭靠近曝氣器會掩蓋遠端缺氧。診斷與介入：比對不同位置 DO 與耗氧率，區分需求改變和傳氧退化。
steps.failureEn: A probe beside an aerator masks remote oxygen depletion. Diagnostic response: Compare spatial DO and oxygen uptake to separate demand changes from transfer deterioration.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「曝氣與溶氧梯度」的觀測點。比對溶氧剖面、耗氧率與尾氣推估。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for aeration and do gradients. Compare DO profiles, oxygen-uptake rate and off-gas estimates. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 缺氧段碳源分配：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Carbon allocation in anoxic zones: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 缺氧段碳源分配 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Carbon allocation in anoxic zones and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 反硝化需要可利用電子供體；把碳先在好氧區耗掉會限制後段脫氮。
steps.instructionEn: Denitrification needs available electron donors; upstream aerobic carbon consumption can limit nitrogen removal.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：NO3-N 去除量=30 kg/d；電子當量=2.86 kg COD/kg N。模型 CODmin=2.86×N，代入得到 85.8 kg COD/d。適用邊界：僅硝酸鹽還原的理論電子當量；不含菌體合成、溶氧與其他耗碳。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: NO3-N removed=30 kg/d; electron equivalent=2.86 kg COD/kg N. Model CODmin=2.86×N gives 85.8 kg COD/d. Applicability: Theoretical nitrate electron equivalent only; biomass synthesis, DO and other carbon demand are omitted.
steps.failure: 剩餘硝酸鹽可能來自缺碳而非缺少池容。診斷與介入：查可利用碳與攜入氧，先核對電子供體收支。
steps.failureEn: Residual nitrate may reflect carbon shortage rather than insufficient volume. Diagnostic response: Check available carbon and oxygen carryover, then close the donor balance.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「缺氧段碳源分配」的觀測點。獨立量測 NO3-N、NO2-N、可利用 COD，避免把總 COD 全算可用。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for carbon allocation in anoxic zones. Measure NO3-N, NO2-N and available COD separately rather than treating all COD as usable. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；C=180 mg/L。模型 L=QC/1000，代入得到 360 kg/d。適用邊界：穩定流量與流量加權濃度；瞬時樣本不代表整日。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; C=180 mg/L. Model L=QC/1000 gives 360 kg/d. Applicability: Steady flow and flow-weighted concentration; a grab sample does not represent a day.

title: 厭氧氨氧化脫氮
summary: 本課以部分亞硝化與厭氧氨氧化的氮收支為主線，從側流氨氮負荷、電子受體配比、前段部分亞硝化、反應器容積負荷進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops nitrogen balances across partial nitritation and anammox through ten connected units, beginning with sidestream ammonium load, electron-acceptor ratio, upstream partial nitritation, reactor volumetric loading. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 側流氨氮負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sidestream ammonium load: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 側流氨氮負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sidestream ammonium load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 消化回流水的高氨濃度須轉成質量負荷，才能與主流比較。
steps.instructionEn: Convert high sidestream ammonium concentration to mass load before comparing it with the mainstream.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=1200 m³/d；NH4-N=40 mg/L。模型 LN=QCN/1000，代入得到 48 kg N/d。適用邊界：所有氮濃度以 N 質量計；不可混用 NH4 的分子質量。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=1200 m³/d; NH4-N=40 mg/L. Model LN=QCN/1000 gives 48 kg N/d. Applicability: All concentrations are on an N-mass basis, not NH4 molecular mass.
steps.failure: 小水量不代表氮負荷小。診斷與介入：把各流股氮物種分列，查核高氨回流是否漏算。
steps.failureEn: Small flow does not imply small nitrogen loading. Diagnostic response: Separate nitrogen species for every stream and check for omitted ammonium-rich returns.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「側流氨氮負荷」的觀測點。校正流量與氨氮儀，保留採樣時段。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。

steps.title: 電子受體配比：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Electron-acceptor ratio: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 電子受體配比 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Electron-acceptor ratio and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 厭氧氨氧化把氨與亞硝酸耦合轉化，兩者不足或過量都須由物種收支辨識。
steps.instructionEn: Anammox couples ammonium and nitrite; diagnose shortage or excess through species balances.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：假設 NH4-N=50 kg/d；NO2-N/NH4-N 化學計量比=1.32。模型 NO2-N=1.32×NH4-N，代入得到 66 kg N/d。適用邊界：選定的厭氧氨氧化化學計量近似，不是通用投料設定。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Assume NH4-N=50 kg/d; nitrite/ammonium N ratio=1.32. Model NO2-N=1.32×NH4-N gives 66 kg N/d. Applicability: A selected anammox stoichiometric approximation, not a universal feeding setpoint.
steps.failure: 只量總氮無法分辨亞硝酸累積。診斷與介入：用同時段氨與亞硝酸分析校對比例，避免單看一支探頭。
steps.failureEn: Total nitrogen alone misses nitrite accumulation. Diagnostic response: Check ratios using time-matched ammonium/nitrite analysis rather than one probe.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「電子受體配比」的觀測點。把氨、亞硝酸與硝酸的氮基準量測放在同一表。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for electron-acceptor ratio. Tabulate ammonium, nitrite and nitrate measurements on the same N basis. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 前段部分亞硝化：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 前段部分亞硝化 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Upstream partial nitritation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 僅將部分氨轉為亞硝酸，保留另一部分作厭氧氨氧化底物。
steps.instructionEn: Oxidize only part of the ammonium to nitrite, retaining the rest for anammox.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：假設亞硝酸與剩餘氨氮需求比 r=1.32。模型 f=r/(1+r)，代入得到 0.56896552 fraction。適用邊界：忽略同化與其他反應的前段部分亞硝化比例；需用實測氮收支校正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Assume required nitrite-to-remaining-ammonium N ratio r=1.32. Model f=r/(1+r) gives 0.56896552 fraction. Applicability: Upstream partial-nitritation fraction ignoring assimilation and side reactions; calibrate against a measured nitrogen balance.
steps.failure: 完全硝化會消耗下游所需的氨與亞硝酸。診斷與介入：重新閉合氮物種收支，將同化與副反應列成獨立項。
steps.failureEn: Complete nitrification consumes needed downstream substrates. Diagnostic response: Reclose species balances with assimilation and side reactions separated.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「前段部分亞硝化」的觀測點。以進出段氮物種確認剩餘氨與所生成亞硝酸。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for upstream partial nitritation. Check remaining ammonium and produced nitrite from inlet/outlet nitrogen species. steps.title: 反應器容積負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Reactor volumetric loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 反應器容積負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Reactor volumetric loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用每日氮量除有效容積建立負荷，但顆粒活性決定實際反應餘裕。
steps.instructionEn: Normalize daily nitrogen by effective volume, while granule activity determines actual reserve.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：N 負荷=100 kg N/d；反應容積=200 m³。模型 NLR=LN/V，代入得到 0.5 kg N/(m³·d)。適用邊界：容積負荷不能代替顆粒活性與可接受毒性資料。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: N load=100 kg N/d; reactor volume=200 m³. Model NLR=LN/V gives 0.5 kg N/(m³·d). Applicability: Volumetric loading does not replace granule activity or inhibition data.
steps.failure: 同容積不同菌量不能假設有相同容量。診斷與介入：查有效容積、活性與顆粒流失，再測負荷敏感度。
steps.failureEn: Equal volumes with different biomass do not have equal capacity. Diagnostic response: Check effective volume, activity and granule loss before a loading sensitivity test.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「反應器容積負荷」的觀測點。把體積、氮負荷、比活性與顆粒流失分列。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for reactor volumetric loading. Record volume, N loading, specific activity and granule loss separately. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 顆粒保留：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 顆粒保留 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Granule retention and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 沉降、篩分或載體保留慢生長菌，水力停留與菌體停留須分開。
steps.instructionEn: Settling, screening or carriers retain slow-growing organisms; distinguish hydraulic and biomass residence.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：固體庫存 MX=4500 kg；排泥=180 kg/d；出流水固體=20 kg/d。模型 SRT=MX/(W+E)，代入得到 22.5 d。適用邊界：全系統固體收支的準穩態估計；回流不是離開系統的排泥。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Solids inventory MX=4500 kg; wasting=180 kg/d; effluent solids=20 kg/d. Model SRT=MX/(W+E) gives 22.5 d. Applicability: Quasi-steady whole-system solids balance; return sludge is not a solids exit.
steps.failure: 失去顆粒後補水量不會恢復菌量。診斷與介入：用實際排出乾固體修正 SRT，分開回流與離開系統的流股。
steps.failureEn: Replacing water after granule loss does not restore biomass. Diagnostic response: Correct SRT with actual exported dry solids, separating recycle from system exits.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「顆粒保留」的觀測點。從排泥流量、含固率與出流水 TSS 各算質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for granule retention. Calculate masses independently from wasting flow, solids fraction and effluent TSS. steps.title: 游離氨分率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Free-ammonia fraction: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 游離氨分率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Free-ammonia fraction and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 同一 TAN 在不同 pH、溫度具有不同 NH3 分率，濃度基準不可混用。
steps.instructionEn: Identical TAN has different NH3 fractions at different pH and temperature; keep reporting bases consistent.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：TAN=50 mg N/L；pH=7.5；假設 pKa=9.25。模型 FA=TAN/(1+10^(pKa-pH))，代入得到 0.87360457 mg NH3-N/L。適用邊界：pKa 隨溫度、離子強度改變；此例不是生物抑制閾值。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: TAN=50 mg N/L; pH=7.5; assumed pKa=9.25. Model FA=TAN/(1+10^(pKa-pH)) gives 0.87360457 mg NH3-N/L. Applicability: pKa varies with temperature and ionic strength; this is not a biological inhibition threshold.

steps.objective: 辨識 停留分布與短流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 示蹤曲線可辨識反應器短流，避免把平均時間當所有水粒子的接觸時間。
steps.instructionEn: Tracer curves reveal bypass rather than assigning the mean contact time to every parcel.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：V=1500 m³；Q=3000 m³/d。模型 θ=24V/Q，代入得到 12 h。適用邊界：名義水力停留時間；不包含短流、死角及回流的停留時間分布。

steps.title: 氮收支與副產物：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Nitrogen balance and by-products: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 氮收支與副產物 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Nitrogen balance and by-products and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 分列氨、亞硝酸、硝酸與菌體，剩餘差額須附量測不確定度。
steps.instructionEn: Separate ammonium, nitrite, nitrate and biomass and attach uncertainty to the residual.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：進流 NH4-N=100、NO2-N=132；出流 NO3-N=26 kg N/d。模型 Nother=Nin-Nout，代入得到 206 kg N/d。適用邊界：未測項包括 N2、菌體與誤差；不能只憑差值宣稱都是氮氣。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Influent NH4-N=100, NO2-N=132; effluent NO3-N=26 kg N/d. Model Nother=Nin-Nout gives 206 kg N/d. Applicability: Unmeasured terms include N2, biomass and error; the residual is not proof that all nitrogen became gas.
steps.failure: 把未測氮全部當 N2 會忽略其他氣態與固態途徑。診斷與介入：另外測固體及其他氮途徑，保留未閉合殘差。
steps.failureEn: Calling all unmeasured nitrogen N2 ignores other gaseous and solid routes. Diagnostic response: Measure solids and other N pathways and retain the unclosed residual.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「氮收支與副產物」的觀測點。另外量菌體固體與各溶解氮，列出收支殘差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for nitrogen balance and by-products. Measure biomass and dissolved nitrogen separately and report the balance residual. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：Q=1200 m³/d；NH4-N=40 mg/L。模型 LN=QCN/1000，代入得到 48 kg N/d。適用邊界：所有氮濃度以 N 質量計；不可混用 NH4 的分子質量。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=1200 m³/d; NH4-N=40 mg/L. Model LN=QCN/1000 gives 48 kg N/d. Applicability: All concentrations are on an N-mass basis, not NH4 molecular mass.

title: 硝化與反硝化分區控制
summary: 本課以分區供氧、回流與碳鹼度協調為主線，從氮物種與負荷基準、硝化理論需氧、硝化鹼度消耗、反硝化電子供體進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops coordinating zonal aeration, recycle, carbon and alkalinity through ten connected units, beginning with species and nitrogen basis, nitrification oxygen balance, alkalinity demand, denitrification donor demand. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 鹼度回復：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Alkalinity recovery: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 鹼度回復 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Alkalinity recovery and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 反硝化可部分補回硝化消耗的鹼度，但回復量依實際轉化量而定。
steps.instructionEn: Denitrification can partly offset nitrification alkalinity demand according to actual conversion.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：反硝化 NO3-N=30 kg/d；回復=3.57 kg CaCO3/kg N。模型 Arec=3.57×N，代入得到 107.1 kg CaCO3/d。適用邊界：只作反硝化鹼度回收的理論收支，不代表所有硝化耗量均回收。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Denitrified NO3-N=30 kg/d; recovery=3.57 kg CaCO3/kg N. Model Arec=3.57×N gives 107.1 kg CaCO3/d. Applicability: Theoretical denitrification recovery, not a claim that all nitrification demand is recovered.
steps.failure: 把理論全回復寫入收支掩蓋未完全反硝化。診斷與介入：將實際反硝化量和鹼度回復配對，保留進流緩衝項。
steps.failureEn: Assuming full recovery masks incomplete denitrification. Diagnostic response: Pair actual denitrification with recovered alkalinity and retain influent buffering.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「鹼度回復」的觀測點。在相同採樣日把硝化耗量、反硝化回復與實測鹼度並列。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for alkalinity recovery. Tabulate nitrification demand, denitrification recovery and measured alkalinity for the same day. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
