steps.title: 內回流與攜氧：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Internal recycle and oxygen carryover: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 內回流與攜氧 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Internal recycle and oxygen carryover and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 增加回流帶回硝酸鹽也帶回氧，可能先耗掉缺氧區碳源。
steps.instructionEn: More recycle returns nitrate but also oxygen, potentially consuming anoxic carbon first.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：回流 Qr=6000 m³/d；進流 Q=3000 m³/d。模型 R=Qr/Q，代入得到 2 ratio。適用邊界：回流提高物質交換也帶回溶氧；比值不是脫氮率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Recycle Qr=6000 m³/d; influent Q=3000 m³/d. Model R=Qr/Q gives 2 ratio. Applicability: Recycle improves exchange but also carries oxygen; the ratio is not nitrogen-removal efficiency.
steps.failure: 只看回流比，未追蹤回流 DO。診斷與介入：量支線流量及 DO，離線比較回流與攜氧折衷。
steps.failureEn: Watching recycle ratio without recycle DO misses the penalty. Diagnostic response: Measure branch flow/DO and compare recycle/oxygen-carryover trade-offs offline.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「內回流與攜氧」的觀測點。量回流支線流量、DO 與 NO3-N，避免只讀泵轉速。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for internal recycle and oxygen carryover. Measure recycle flow, DO and nitrate instead of using pump speed alone. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Recycle Qr=6000 m³/d; influent Q=3000 m³/d. Model R=Qr/Q gives 2 ratio. Applicability: Recycle improves exchange but also carries oxygen; the ratio is not nitrogen-removal efficiency.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 Qr:6000→7500 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2 變為 2.5 ratio。用「內回流與攜氧」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Qr:6000→7500 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2 to 2.5 ratio. Explain the direction using internal recycle and oxygen carryover, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 溶氧儀校正：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: DO-probe calibration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 溶氧儀校正 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of DO-probe calibration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 分區控制依賴可信感測值，偏移會把正常程序推到錯誤方向。
steps.instructionEn: Zonal control needs credible measurements; sensor bias drives the process in the wrong direction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：參考濃度 x1=0、x2=8 mg/L；儀器讀值 y1=0.2、y2=7.8。模型 slope=(y2-y1)/(x2-x1)，代入得到 0.95 ratio。適用邊界：二點線性校正不能驗證全量程非線性；另留獨立檢查點。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Reference x1=0, x2=8 mg/L; readings y1=0.2, y2=7.8. Model slope=(y2-y1)/(x2-x1) gives 0.95 ratio. Applicability: Two-point calibration does not validate full-range nonlinearity; reserve an independent check point.
steps.failure: 探頭污染被誤認為真實氧需求改變。診斷與介入：清潔並依方法校正感測器，以獨立檢查點驗證。
steps.failureEn: Probe fouling is mistaken for changing oxygen demand. Diagnostic response: Clean/calibrate by the relevant method and verify using an independent point.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「溶氧儀校正」的觀測點。用第三個參考點比較校正殘差與容許誤差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for do-probe calibration. Compare a third reference point with calibration residual and required tolerance. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 回流水混合：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Recycle blending: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 回流水混合 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Recycle blending and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 高濃度側流水須用質量加權混合，不能平均兩個濃度數字。
steps.instructionEn: Blend concentrated sidestreams by mass weighting, not an arithmetic concentration mean.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q1=1000、Q2=500 m³/d；C1=20、C2=80 mg/L。模型 Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)，代入得到 40 mg/L。適用邊界：無反應、同一成分與相同濃度基準；不可直接套用 pH。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q1=1000, Q2=500 m³/d; C1=20, C2=80 mg/L. Model Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2) gives 40 mg/L. Applicability: No reaction and the same species/concentration basis; do not directly average pH this way.
steps.failure: 低流量高氨流股可能控制負荷尖峰。診斷與介入：核對兩股流量及同成分分析，避免以簡單平均混合。
steps.failureEn: A small high-ammonium stream can dominate peak loading. Diagnostic response: Check both flows and same-species analyses rather than arithmetic averaging.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「回流水混合」的觀測點。量兩股流量與成分，再在混合充分的位置採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for recycle blending. Measure both flows and concentrations, then sample after adequate mixing. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：Q=1200 m³/d；NH4-N=40 mg/L。模型 LN=QCN/1000，代入得到 48 kg N/d。適用邊界：所有氮濃度以 N 質量計；不可混用 NH4 的分子質量。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=1200 m³/d; NH4-N=40 mg/L. Model LN=QCN/1000 gives 48 kg N/d. Applicability: All concentrations are on an N-mass basis, not NH4 molecular mass.

title: 生物除磷程序
summary: 本課以厭氧釋磷、好氧吸磷與排泥閉合為主線，從總磷與溶解磷、厭氧選擇區、可利用碳與磷比例、厭氧釋磷觀察進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops closing anaerobic release, aerobic uptake and phosphorus wasting through ten connected units, beginning with total and dissolved phosphorus, anaerobic selection zone, available carbon-to-p balance, anaerobic release observation. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 總磷與溶解磷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Total and dissolved phosphorus: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 總磷與溶解磷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Total and dissolved phosphorus and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先分清顆粒磷與溶解磷，才能區分生物吸收不足及固體分離問題。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish particulate from dissolved P to separate poor uptake from separation problems.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=2500 m³/d；TP=6 mg P/L。模型 LP=QCP/1000，代入得到 15 kg P/d。適用邊界：TP 與溶解性磷須分開；流量加權後再計算。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2500 m³/d; TP=6 mg P/L. Model LP=QCP/1000 gives 15 kg P/d. Applicability: Separate total and dissolved phosphorus; use flow weighting.

steps.objective: 辨識 可利用碳與磷比例 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Available carbon-to-P balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 聚磷菌需要合適的可利用碳；總 COD 高不代表 VFA 足夠。
steps.instructionEn: PAOs require suitable available carbon; high total COD does not imply enough VFA.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：可利用 COD=120 kg/d；需移除 P=8 kg/d。模型 C/P=COD/P，代入得到 15 kg COD/kg P。適用邊界：進流水質指標而非通用最低需求；須區分 VFA 與其他 COD。

steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「可利用碳與磷比例」的觀測點。將 VFA、可快速降解 COD 與正磷酸鹽一起採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for available carbon-to-p balance. Sample VFA, readily biodegradable COD and orthophosphate together. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.objective: 辨識 厭氧釋磷觀察 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 厭氧時水相磷上升可反映儲存轉換，須與碳吸收、停留時間一起看。
steps.instructionEn: Aqueous P release can reflect storage conversion; interpret it with carbon uptake and residence.

steps.failure: 只憑釋磷判定全廠磷已去除。診斷與介入：按水力延遲配對採樣，檢查硝酸鹽和氧入侵。
steps.failureEn: Release alone is mistaken for plant removal. Diagnostic response: Pair samples by hydraulic lag and check nitrate/oxygen intrusion.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「厭氧釋磷觀察」的觀測點。依流動延遲配對入口與出口採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for anaerobic release observation. Pair inlet and outlet samples using the hydraulic delay. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.objective: 辨識 富磷排泥 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Phosphorus-rich wasting and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 排泥量與乾基含磷率一起決定排出的磷質量。
steps.instructionEn: Wasted dry mass and its P fraction determine phosphorus export.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：乾固體排泥=150 kg/d；污泥 P 質量分率=0.04。模型 Pout=MDS fP，代入得到 6 kg P/d。適用邊界：均勻代表樣本與乾基含磷率；濕污泥重量不能直接代入。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Dry solids wasted=150 kg/d; sludge P fraction=0.04. Model Pout=MDS fP gives 6 kg P/d. Applicability: Representative sampling and dry-basis P fraction; wet sludge mass cannot be substituted.
steps.failure: 濕泥重量造成固體與磷高估。診斷與介入：重算乾固體與乾基含磷率，將濕重和元素質量分開。
steps.failureEn: Wet mass overstates solids and phosphorus. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry solids and dry-basis P content separately from wet mass.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「富磷排泥」的觀測點。稱重乾固體後分析 P，與水線進出量閉合。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for phosphorus-rich wasting. Measure dry mass and P content and close the balance against the water line. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 富磷排泥
knowledge.text: 排泥量與乾基含磷率一起決定排出的磷質量。
knowledge.textEn: Wasted dry mass and its P fraction determine phosphorus export.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 MDS:150→180 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 6 變為 7.2 kg P/d。用「富磷排泥」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only MDS:150→180 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 6 to 7.2 kg P/d. Explain the direction using phosphorus-rich wasting, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?

optionsEn: Wetter cake exports more phosphorus.

An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.

Measure dry mass and P content and close the balance against the water line. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 硝酸鹽入侵：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Nitrate intrusion: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 硝酸鹽入侵 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Nitrate intrusion and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 回流硝酸鹽先消耗碳，可能使厭氧儲碳功能減弱。
steps.instructionEn: Recycled nitrate consumes carbon before anaerobic storage and can weaken selection.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：NO3-N 去除量=30 kg/d；電子當量=2.86 kg COD/kg N。模型 CODmin=2.86×N，代入得到 85.8 kg COD/d。適用邊界：僅硝酸鹽還原的理論電子當量；不含菌體合成、溶氧與其他耗碳。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: NO3-N removed=30 kg/d; electron equivalent=2.86 kg COD/kg N. Model CODmin=2.86×N gives 85.8 kg COD/d. Applicability: Theoretical nitrate electron equivalent only; biomass synthesis, DO and other carbon demand are omitted.
steps.failure: 只調曝氣而不追蹤回流硝酸鹽。診斷與介入：查可利用碳與攜入氧，先核對電子供體收支。
steps.failureEn: Changing aeration alone misses recycle nitrate. Diagnostic response: Check available carbon and oxygen carryover, then close the donor balance.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「硝酸鹽入侵」的觀測點。獨立量測 NO3-N、NO2-N、可利用 COD，避免把總 COD 全算可用。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for nitrate intrusion. Measure NO3-N, NO2-N and available COD separately rather than treating all COD as usable. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.instructionEn: Original teaching assumptions: NO3-N removed=30 kg/d; electron equivalent=2.86 kg COD/kg N. Model CODmin=2.86×N gives 85.8 kg COD/d. Applicability: Theoretical nitrate electron equivalent only; biomass synthesis, DO and other carbon demand are omitted.

steps.title: 顆粒磷逃逸：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Particulate phosphorus escape: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 顆粒磷逃逸 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Particulate phosphorus escape and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 低溶解磷仍可能伴隨出流水固體帶出的高總磷。
steps.instructionEn: Low dissolved P can coexist with high total P carried by effluent solids.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：出流水 TSS=10 mg/L；固體含磷率=0.04。模型 Ppart=TSS fP，代入得到 0.4 mg P/L。適用邊界：把固體組成當固定的教學近似；還須加上溶解磷。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Effluent TSS=10 mg/L; solids P fraction=0.04. Model Ppart=TSS fP gives 0.4 mg P/L. Applicability: Assumes constant solids composition; dissolved P must also be included.
steps.failure: 只優化菌相而忽略沉澱與過濾。診斷與介入：比較過濾前後磷與 TSS，優先診斷固體逃逸。
steps.failureEn: Optimizing biology while neglecting separation leaves P losses. Diagnostic response: Compare filtered/unfiltered P and TSS, first diagnosing solids escape.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「顆粒磷逃逸」的觀測點。比較過濾前後總磷與 TSS。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for particulate phosphorus escape. Compare filtered/unfiltered phosphorus with TSS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 污泥齡折衷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sludge-age trade-off: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污泥齡折衷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sludge-age trade-off and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 保留菌體與排出磷須共同安排，不能只追求最大固體庫存。
steps.instructionEn: Coordinate biomass retention and P export rather than maximizing inventory alone.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：固體庫存 MX=4500 kg；排泥=180 kg/d；出流水固體=20 kg/d。模型 SRT=MX/(W+E)，代入得到 22.5 d。適用邊界：全系統固體收支的準穩態估計；回流不是離開系統的排泥。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Solids inventory MX=4500 kg; wasting=180 kg/d; effluent solids=20 kg/d. Model SRT=MX/(W+E) gives 22.5 d. Applicability: Quasi-steady whole-system solids balance; return sludge is not a solids exit.
steps.failure: 排泥過低使磷出口不足。診斷與介入：用實際排出乾固體修正 SRT，分開回流與離開系統的流股。
steps.failureEn: Insufficient wasting restricts P export. Diagnostic response: Correct SRT with actual exported dry solids, separating recycle from system exits.

steps.instruction: 把進流、出水、污泥、側流與庫存放在同一磷收支。

steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Input=15, effluent=2, sludge=12 kg/d. Model ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge gives 1 kg/d. Applicability: Residual can reflect storage, omitted side streams or measurement error, not automatically a reaction.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：Q=2500 m³/d；TP=6 mg P/L。模型 LP=QCP/1000，代入得到 15 kg P/d。適用邊界：TP 與溶解性磷須分開；流量加權後再計算。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2500 m³/d; TP=6 mg P/L. Model LP=QCP/1000 gives 15 kg P/d. Applicability: Separate total and dissolved phosphorus; use flow weighting.

title: 污水化學除磷
summary: 本課以金屬鹽化學計量、膠體分離與新增污泥為主線，從除磷目標與成分、元素莫耳配比、活性成分日量、藥液濃度與密度進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops metal-salt stoichiometry, colloid separation and added sludge through ten connected units, beginning with phosphorus target and fractions, elemental molar ratio, daily active-component mass, solution fraction and density. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

stages.title: 設備操作與量測

steps.title: 快速分散與均勻性：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Rapid distribution and uniformity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 快速分散與均勻性 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Rapid distribution and uniformity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 反應初期需充分分散，局部過濃可能造成耗藥與不均勻絮體。
steps.instructionEn: Early reagent distribution matters; local excess wastes chemical and creates uneven floc.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：P=100 W；μ=0.001 Pa·s；V=10 m³。模型 G=sqrt(P/(μV))，代入得到 100 s⁻¹。適用邊界：耗散功率平均值，不等於馬達銘牌功率或局部剪切。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: P=100 W; viscosity=0.001 Pa·s; V=10 m³. Model G=sqrt(P/(μV)) gives 100 s⁻¹. Applicability: Mean dissipated power, not nameplate motor power or local shear.
steps.failure: 攪拌器有轉動不代表混合均勻。診斷與介入：查實際傳入水中功率、黏度與死角，觀察絮體而非只看電表。
steps.failureEn: A rotating mixer does not prove uniform mixing. Diagnostic response: Check power delivered to water, viscosity and dead zones, observing flocs rather than electricity alone.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「快速分散與均勻性」的觀測點。校正軸功率、黏度與有效槽容，觀察局部絮體破碎。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for rapid distribution and uniformity. Check shaft power, viscosity and effective volume and observe local floc breakage. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 膠凝接觸：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Flocculation exposure: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 膠凝接觸 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Flocculation exposure and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 膠凝讓微小沉澱形成可分離絮體，過剪切會再次破碎。
steps.instructionEn: Flocculation aggregates fine precipitates; excessive shear breaks them again.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：G=40 s⁻¹；t=1200 s。模型 Gt=G×t，代入得到 48000 dimensionless。適用邊界：平均剪切指標，不含局部過度剪切與絮體破碎；非單獨驗收標準。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: G=40 s⁻¹; t=1200 s. Model Gt=G×t gives 48000 dimensionless. Applicability: Mean shear exposure, excluding local overshear and floc breakage; not a sole acceptance criterion.
steps.failure: 只延長時間而忽略局部剪切。診斷與介入：同時比較絮體破碎、沉降和殘濁，離線修正混合分段。
steps.failureEn: Longer time alone ignores local shear. Diagnostic response: Compare breakup, settling and residual turbidity while revising mixing stages offline.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「膠凝接觸」的觀測點。觀察絮體尺寸、沉降性與攪拌功率。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for flocculation exposure. Observe floc size, settleability and mixing power. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 瓶杯試驗與空白：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 瓶杯試驗與空白 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Jar testing and controls and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 同批原水設空白與平行杯，將 pH、劑量與攪拌分開比較。
steps.instructionEn: Use blanks and replicates on one raw-water batch and separate pH, dose and mixing changes.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：原水濁度=50 NTU；沉降後=5 NTU。模型 ηT=(T0-T)/T0，代入得到 0.9 fraction。適用邊界：濁度指標不是污染物質量或病原去除率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Raw turbidity=50 NTU; settled turbidity=5 NTU. Model ηT=(T0-T)/T0 gives 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Turbidity reduction is not contaminant mass or pathogen removal.

steps.failureEn: Changing three variables together hides causality. Diagnostic response: Repeat parallel tests on one water batch, separating dose, shear and time effects.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「瓶杯試驗與空白」的觀測點。所有杯使用相同攪拌、沉降時間並同時量 pH。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for jar testing and controls. Use matching mixing/settling times across jars and measure pH. steps.instruction: 以磷收支與殘餘金屬分析判讀效果，不將提高投量視為唯一解方。

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：Q=2500 m³/d；TP=6 mg P/L。模型 LP=QCP/1000，代入得到 15 kg P/d。適用邊界：TP 與溶解性磷須分開；流量加權後再計算。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2500 m³/d; TP=6 mg P/L. Model LP=QCP/1000 gives 15 kg P/d. Applicability: Separate total and dissolved phosphorus; use flow weighting.

title: 污泥厭氧消化
summary: 本課以水解、酸化、產甲烷與能源收支為主線，從進料乾固體基準、有機容積負荷、有效消化時間、揮發固體轉化進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops hydrolysis, acidogenesis, methanogenesis and energy balances through ten connected units, beginning with feed dry-solids basis, organic volumetric loading, effective digestion time, volatile-solids conversion. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 進料乾固體基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Feed dry-solids basis: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 進料乾固體基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Feed dry-solids basis and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 體積進料必須換算乾固體及揮發固體，才可比較不同污泥。
steps.instructionEn: Convert feed volume to dry and volatile solids before comparing sludges.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.
steps.failure: 含水率變動掩蓋有機負荷增加。診斷與介入：用代表性含固樣本重算乾量，避免濕重混用。
steps.failureEn: Moisture changes can mask organic-load increases. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry mass from representative solids samples, without mixing wet mass.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「進料乾固體基準」的觀測點。由體積、密度與烘乾固體三個獨立量測建質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed dry-solids basis. Build mass from independent volume, density and oven-dry solids measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.instruction: 酸化與產甲烷速度不一致時，進料增加可能先累積酸。
steps.instructionEn: When acidogenesis and methanogenesis differ, increased feeding may accumulate acids first.

steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: VS feed=1500 kg/d; digester volume=1000 m³. Model OLR=MVS/V gives 1.5 kg VS/(m³·d). Applicability: Organic loading only, not an allowable limit; VS and COD are distinct bases.
steps.failure: 只依槽容增加進料。診斷與介入：查 VS 進料與有效槽容，將酸鹼及產氣趨勢一同判讀。

steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for organic volumetric loading. Measure feed volume and VS and pair with temperature/acidity trends. steps.instruction: 有機物轉化與氣體回收是不同步驟，溶解甲烷、漏氣及菌體合成形成差額。

steps.observation: 原創教學假設：被轉化 COD=800 kg/d；假設產率=0.35 m³ CH4/kg COD。模型 VCH4=Y×COD，代入得到 280 m³ CH4/d。適用邊界：以指定標準溫壓及完全轉化的教學理論值；非實際保證產氣。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Converted COD=800 kg/d; assumed yield=0.35 m³ CH4/kg COD. Model VCH4=Y×COD gives 280 m³ CH4/d. Applicability: Teaching theoretical value at a stated standard condition and complete conversion, not guaranteed gas production.
steps.failure: 理論產率直接當保證產氣。診斷與介入：把氣體標準狀態與甲烷比例校正，另列溶解和漏失項。
steps.failureEn: Theoretical yield is treated as guaranteed gas output. Diagnostic response: Normalize gas conditions/methane fraction and separately list dissolved and leakage losses.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「產甲烷潛勢」的觀測點。校正氣體溫壓、甲烷分率與溶解甲烷漏項。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: VFA=300 mg/L as acetic-acid equivalent; alkalinity=3000 mg/L as CaCO3. Model R=VFA/Alkalinity gives 0.1 reported-basis ratio. Applicability: Different analytical bases; use only consistent-method trend comparison, not an unverified universal limit.

steps.title: 進料顯熱：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Feed sensible heating: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 進料顯熱 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Feed sensible heating and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 加熱負荷隨含水量與進料溫度變化，過量稀釋增加熱需求。
steps.instructionEn: Heating varies with moisture and feed temperature; dilution increases thermal demand.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：污泥質量 m=1000 kg；cp=4 kJ/(kg·K)；ΔT=20 K。模型 Q=m cp ΔT，代入得到 80 MJ。適用邊界：顯熱近似，不含散熱、相變與容器升溫。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge mass m=1000 kg; cp=4 kJ/(kg·K); ΔT=20 K. Model Q=m cp ΔT gives 80 MJ. Applicability: Sensible-heat approximation, excluding heat losses, phase change and vessel heating.
steps.failure: 只計反應溫度而漏掉冷進料。診斷與介入：更新進料量、含水率和溫度，再核對熱損及回收。
steps.failureEn: Considering reactor temperature alone misses cold-feed load. Diagnostic response: Update feed, moisture and temperature and check heat loss/recovery.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「進料顯熱」的觀測點。對照進出口溫度、質量及熱媒供應量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed sensible heating. Compare inlet/outlet temperatures, mass and heating-medium supply. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 消化回流水氮：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Digestion return-liquid nitrogen: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 消化回流水氮 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Digestion return-liquid nitrogen and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 蛋白質轉化後釋出的氨會回到水線，須列入整廠氮負荷。
steps.instructionEn: Ammonium released from protein conversion returns to the water line and belongs in the plant nitrogen balance.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：回流水 Q=80 m³/d；NH4-N=600 mg/L。模型 LN=QCN/1000，代入得到 48 kg N/d。適用邊界：日平均回流負荷；瞬時排放會造成更高的時段尖峰。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Return liquid Q=80 m³/d; NH4-N=600 mg/L. Model LN=QCN/1000 gives 48 kg N/d. Applicability: Daily mean recycle load; batch discharge causes larger short-term peaks.
steps.failure: 忽略脫水回流造成主流突然氨負荷。診斷與介入：將側流量與氨氮同步採樣，納入主流水線負荷。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring dewatering returns creates unexpected mainstream ammonium peaks. Diagnostic response: Sample sidestream flow/ammonium synchronously and include them in mainstream load.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「消化回流水氮」的觀測點。記錄脫水運行時段、回流量與氨氮。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for digestion return-liquid nitrogen. Record dewatering hours, recycle flow and ammonium. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.instruction: 產氣量、甲烷濃度、發電效率及自用熱共同決定能源收益。

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.

title: 污泥熱水解前處理
summary: 本課以熱水解前處理與消化系統整合為主線，從污泥組成與進料邊界、水解顯熱模型、蒸汽熱焓收支、熱回收與溫位進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops thermal-hydrolysis pretreatment and digestion integration through ten connected units, beginning with sludge composition and feed boundary, hydrolysis sensible-heat model, steam enthalpy balance, recovery and temperature grade. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 污泥組成與進料邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sludge composition and feed boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污泥組成與進料邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sludge composition and feed boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 初沉與生物污泥的可水解性不同，先確認混合比例與乾固體。
steps.instructionEn: Primary and biological sludges differ in hydrolysability; establish blend and dry solids first.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.
steps.failure: 只看濕重忽略組成。診斷與介入：用代表性含固樣本重算乾量，避免濕重混用。

steps.title: 蒸汽熱焓收支：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Steam enthalpy balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 蒸汽熱焓收支 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Steam enthalpy balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 蒸汽供熱取決於進出熱焓差，不能把蒸汽公斤數直接當能量。
steps.instructionEn: Steam heating depends on inlet/outlet enthalpy difference, not mass alone.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：熱需求=400 MJ；假設有效冷凝放熱=2 MJ/kg。模型 ms=Q/huse，代入得到 200 kg steam。適用邊界：選定熱焓差的平衡例；蒸汽壓力、冷凝水與閥件不可由此例設計。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Heat demand=400 MJ; assumed useful condensation heat=2 MJ/kg. Model ms=Q/huse gives 200 kg steam. Applicability: Balance using an assumed useful enthalpy difference; not a design of steam pressure, condensate or valves.
steps.failure: 忽略冷凝水返回狀態。診斷與介入：採用一致蒸汽及冷凝水熱焓基準，關閉能量收支。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring returning condensate state distorts the balance. Diagnostic response: Use consistent steam/condensate enthalpy bases and close the energy balance.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「蒸汽熱焓收支」的觀測點。按實際熱焓狀態與冷凝水回收邊界重列能量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for steam enthalpy balance. Rebuild the energy balance using actual enthalpy states and condensate boundary. steps.objective: 辨識 熱回收與溫位 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Recovery and temperature grade and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 閃蒸與熱交換可回收熱，但低溫熱未必能供應高溫需求。
steps.instructionEn: Flash/heat exchange recover energy, but low-grade heat cannot necessarily satisfy high-temperature demand.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：可回收熱源=400 MJ；假設回收率=0.65。模型 Qrec=Qη，代入得到 260 MJ。適用邊界：只按能量回收率，不包含溫位與換熱最小溫差限制。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Available heat=400 MJ; assumed recovery fraction=0.65. Model Qrec=Qη gives 260 MJ. Applicability: Energy-fraction estimate only; temperature grade and minimum approach are omitted.
steps.failure: 把所有回收熱視為同等有用。診斷與介入：核對熱源與熱需求溫位，避免把低溫回熱全算可用。
steps.failureEn: Treating recovered heat of every temperature as equally useful fails. Diagnostic response: Check source/demand temperature grades before counting recovered heat as usable.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「熱回收與溫位」的觀測點。畫出冷熱物流溫度區間，確認回收熱仍有可用溫差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for recovery and temperature grade. Plot hot/cold temperature ranges and check usable driving temperature difference. steps.title: 批次排程：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 批次排程 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Batch scheduling and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 多批次共用蒸汽與下游容量，整數批次和等待時間決定日產能。
steps.instructionEn: Shared steam and downstream capacity make whole batches and waits decisive for daily throughput.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：每批=8 t wet；循環=2 h；每天可用=20 h。模型 Mday=Mbatch floor(tavail/tcycle)，代入得到 80 t wet/d。適用邊界：完整批次數取整數，需另扣清洗、等待與異常，不是承諾產能。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Batch mass=8 t wet; cycle=2 h; available time=20 h/d. Model Mday=Mbatch floor(tavail/tcycle) gives 80 t wet/d. Applicability: Count whole batches; cleaning, waits and faults require deductions, so this is not guaranteed throughput.
steps.failure: 用小數批次虛增產能。診斷與介入：把清洗、停機與不完整批次明列，再調整排程。

steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「批次排程」的觀測點。建立批次事件時間表，檢查共同蒸汽源是否衝突。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for batch scheduling. Build an event schedule and check conflicts for the shared steam source. steps.instruction: 水解與消化改變氮的液固分配，脫水回流氨應納入主水線。

steps.objective: 辨識 脫水效益辨識 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Dewatering-benefit assessment and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 比較前後泥餅含固率時，必須固定乾固體輸入與聚合物基準。
steps.instructionEn: Compare cake solids at fixed dry-solids input and polymer basis.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：DS=2000 kg/d；泥餅 TS=0.25。模型 Mcake=MDS/TS，代入得到 8000 kg wet cake/d。適用邊界：假定乾固體完全進入泥餅；實際需校正捕集率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: DS=2000 kg/d; cake TS=0.25. Model Mcake=MDS/TS gives 8000 kg wet cake/d. Applicability: Assumes all dry solids enter the cake; correct for actual capture.
steps.failure: 含固率上升被誤算成乾固體消失。診斷與介入：同步量乾固體與泥餅重量，查固體回收率是否變化。
steps.failureEn: Higher cake solids are mistaken for lost dry solids. Diagnostic response: Measure dry solids and wet cake together and check capture changes.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「脫水效益辨識」的觀測點。稱泥餅並分析含固率，與進料 DS 閉合。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for dewatering-benefit assessment. Weigh cake, analyze solids fraction and close against feed DS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.

title: 污泥離心脫水
summary: 本課以離心場、相對螺旋速度與固體捕集為主線，從乾固體進料、離心加速度、螺旋相對速度、聚合物乾基換算進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops centrifugal field, differential scroll speed and solids capture through ten connected units, beginning with dry-solids feed, centrifugal acceleration, scroll differential speed, dry-basis polymer conversion. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 固體捕集與濾液：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Capture and centrate: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 固體捕集與濾液 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Capture and centrate and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 泥餅變乾和捕集率提高不是同一件事，液相固體流失須獨立量測。
steps.instructionEn: Drier cake differs from better capture; measure centrate solids loss independently.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：進料固體=2000 kg/d；液相流失=100 kg/d。模型 η=(Min-Mloss)/Min，代入得到 0.95 fraction。適用邊界：穩態乾固體收支；不可用清澈外觀代替液相 TSS。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Feed solids=2000 kg/d; liquid-phase loss=100 kg/d. Model η=(Min-Mloss)/Min gives 0.95 fraction. Applicability: Steady dry-solids balance; clear appearance is not a substitute for liquid-phase TSS.
steps.failure: 外觀清澈仍可能有可量測固體負荷。診斷與介入：重新量進料、濾液及泥餅固體，查回流水漏項。
steps.failureEn: Clear-looking centrate can still carry solids load. Diagnostic response: Remeasure feed, filtrate and cake solids and check omitted returns.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「固體捕集與濾液」的觀測點。量回流水量與 TSS，與泥餅 DS 相互驗證。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for capture and centrate. Measure return-liquid flow/TSS and cross-check cake dry solids. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.instruction: 消化污泥離心液常把溶解氮送回水線，排放時間影響尖峰。
steps.instructionEn: Centrate from digested sludge returns soluble nitrogen, with timing affecting peaks.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：回流水 Q=80 m³/d；NH4-N=600 mg/L。模型 LN=QCN/1000，代入得到 48 kg N/d。適用邊界：日平均回流負荷；瞬時排放會造成更高的時段尖峰。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Return liquid Q=80 m³/d; NH4-N=600 mg/L. Model LN=QCN/1000 gives 48 kg N/d. Applicability: Daily mean recycle load; batch discharge causes larger short-term peaks.
steps.failure: 每日平均遮住短時氨峰值。診斷與介入：將側流量與氨氮同步採樣，納入主流水線負荷。
steps.failureEn: Daily means hide short ammonium peaks. Diagnostic response: Sample sidestream flow/ammonium synchronously and include them in mainstream load.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「回流水氨負荷」的觀測點。記錄脫水運行時段、回流量與氨氮。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for centrate ammonium load. Record dewatering hours, recycle flow and ammonium. steps.title: 整機質量閉合：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Machine mass closure: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 整機質量閉合 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Machine mass closure and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 進料、泥餅、濾液三端乾固體應閉合，剩餘差額指向庫存或量測問題。
steps.instructionEn: Close dry solids across feed, cake and centrate; residuals indicate inventory or measurement issues.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：進入=15、出流水=2、排泥=12 kg/d。模型 ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge，代入得到 1 kg/d。適用邊界：殘差可能來自儲存、漏算旁流與量測誤差，不能自動當作反應。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Input=15, effluent=2, sludge=12 kg/d. Model ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge gives 1 kg/d. Applicability: Residual can reflect storage, omitted side streams or measurement error, not automatically a reaction.
steps.failure: 只量進料與泥餅而遺漏濾液。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
steps.failureEn: Omitting centrate leaves the balance incomplete. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「整機質量閉合」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for machine mass closure. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.

title: 污泥帶濾式脫水
summary: 本課以重力排水、楔形壓榨與帶面負荷為主線，從進料乾固體、調理與藥劑活性、重力排水接觸、帶寬固體負荷進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops gravity drainage, wedge pressing and belt loading through ten connected units, beginning with feed dry solids, conditioning and active polymer, gravity-drainage contact, solids per belt width. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 調理與藥劑活性：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Conditioning and active polymer: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 調理與藥劑活性 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Conditioning and active polymer and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 聚合物促進絮凝與自由水釋出，效果取決於污泥而非固定通用劑量。
steps.instructionEn: Polymer promotes flocculation and free-water release; performance depends on sludge, not a universal dose.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：DS=2000 kg/d；假設用量=4 kg active/t DS。模型 Mpoly=MDS D/1000，代入得到 8 kg active/d。適用邊界：只示範乾基換算；最佳用量須由污泥試驗判定。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: DS=2000 kg/d; assumed dose=4 kg active/t DS. Model Mpoly=MDS D/1000 gives 8 kg active/d. Applicability: Dry-basis conversion only; appropriate dose requires sludge testing.
steps.failure: 過量聚合物可能黏帶而非改善排水。診斷與介入：校核有效聚合物乾基，將藥耗與泥餅及濾液表現比較。
steps.failureEn: Excess polymer can blind the belt instead of improving drainage. Diagnostic response: Check active polymer on a dry-solids basis and compare consumption with cake/filtrate performance.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「調理與藥劑活性」的觀測點。把稀釋藥液量還原成活性聚合物，觀察絮體與濾液。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for conditioning and active polymer. Convert solution use to active polymer and observe floc and filtrate. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.textEn: Change only D:4→5 kg/t DS, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 8 to 10 kg active/d. steps.title: 重力排水接觸：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Gravity-drainage contact: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 重力排水接觸 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Gravity-drainage contact and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 重力段先排自由水，後段壓力無法完全補救進料過厚與絮體破壞。
steps.instructionEn: Drain free water first; later pressing cannot fully repair thick feed or damaged floc.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：有效帶長=6 m；帶速=1 m/min。模型 t=L/v，代入得到 6 min。適用邊界：幾何停留估計，不能單憑延長時間預測最終含固率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Effective belt length=6 m; belt speed=1 m/min. Model t=L/v gives 6 min. Applicability: Geometric residence estimate; time alone does not predict final solids fraction.
steps.failure: 過快帶速縮短初始排水時間。診斷與介入：以實際速度和有效長度重算，配對濾液及泥餅資料。
steps.failureEn: Excess belt speed shortens initial drainage. Diagnostic response: Recalculate with actual speed/effective length and pair with filtrate/cake data.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「重力排水接觸」的觀測點。對照帶速紀錄、重力段排水與泥餅含固率。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for gravity-drainage contact. Compare belt speed, gravity-zone drainage and cake solids. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 洗帶用水：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Belt washing water: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 洗帶用水 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Belt washing water and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 清洗維持通透，但洗水回流增加水線負荷，需計入水量。
steps.instructionEn: Cleaning maintains permeability but its return flow loads the water line.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：沖洗水流量=2 m³/h；每日沖洗運轉=8 h。模型 Vwash=Qt，代入得到 16 m³/d。適用邊界：只有水量收支，不是噴嘴壓力或衛生保證；回流水負荷仍需採樣。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Wash-water flow=2 m³/h; daily washing operation=8 h. Model Vwash=Qt gives 16 m³/d. Applicability: Water balance only, not nozzle-pressure or hygienic assurance; sample return-stream loads separately.
steps.failure: 洗水漏列使淨產水量高估。診斷與介入：獨立量沖洗用水和回流負荷，確認噴嘴及濾帶狀態。
steps.failureEn: Omitted washwater overstates net water output. Diagnostic response: Meter wash water and return loads separately and inspect nozzles/belt condition.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「洗帶用水」的觀測點。以獨立沖洗支線水表與運轉紀錄交叉核對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for belt washing water. Cross-check a dedicated wash-water meter with operating logs. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.instruction: 濾液的 TSS 與流量共同決定回流固體，不可只看色澤。
steps.instructionEn: Filtrate TSS and flow determine returned solids; color alone is insufficient.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：進料固體=2000 kg/d；液相流失=100 kg/d。模型 η=(Min-Mloss)/Min，代入得到 0.95 fraction。適用邊界：穩態乾固體收支；不可用清澈外觀代替液相 TSS。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Feed solids=2000 kg/d; liquid-phase loss=100 kg/d. Model η=(Min-Mloss)/Min gives 0.95 fraction. Applicability: Steady dry-solids balance; clear appearance is not a substitute for liquid-phase TSS.

steps.failureEn: Dilution makes filtrate look clearer without removing its mass. Diagnostic response: Remeasure feed, filtrate and cake solids and check omitted returns.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「液相固體捕集」的觀測點。量回流水量與 TSS，與泥餅 DS 相互驗證。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for liquid-phase capture. Measure return-liquid flow/TSS and cross-check cake dry solids. scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。

title: 污泥乾燥與熱回收
summary: 本課以水分蒸發、熱回收與乾燥系統邊界為主線，從濕乾基分辨、蒸發水量、汽化潛熱、進料與產品顯熱進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops evaporation, heat recovery and dryer system boundaries through ten connected units, beginning with wet and dry bases, evaporated-water balance, latent-heat requirement, feed and product sensible heat. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 蒸發水量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Evaporated-water balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 蒸發水量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Evaporated-water balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 乾燥主要減少水而非乾固體，產品濕重隨含固率非線性變化。
steps.instructionEn: Drying primarily removes water, not dry solids; wet mass changes nonlinearly with solids fraction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：乾固體=1000 kg；進料 TS=0.25；產品 TS=0.90。模型 Mevap=MDS(1/TSin-1/TSout)，代入得到 2888.8889 kg water。適用邊界：假定乾固體無損失；揮發有機物與粉塵另列。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Dry solids=1000 kg; feed TS=0.25; product TS=0.90. Model Mevap=MDS(1/TSin-1/TSout) gives 2888.8889 kg water. Applicability: Assumes conserved dry solids; volatile organics and dust require separate terms.
steps.failure: 未列粉塵與揮發損失就宣稱固體全守恆。診斷與介入：先由乾固體收支確認需去除水量，再比較熱負荷。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring dust/volatile losses overstates exact solids conservation. Diagnostic response: Confirm water removal through the dry-solids balance before comparing heat demand.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「蒸發水量」的觀測點。由進料、產品及冷凝水重量重建水分收支。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for evaporated-water balance. Rebuild the water balance from feed, product and condensate masses. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 汽化潛熱：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Latent-heat requirement: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 汽化潛熱 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Latent-heat requirement and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把蒸發潛熱與升溫顯熱分開，才知道熱回收改善哪一部分。
steps.instructionEn: Separate evaporation latent heat from sensible heating to locate heat-recovery benefits.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：蒸發水=1000 kg；假設有效汽化潛熱=2.3 MJ/kg。模型 Qlat=mλ，代入得到 2300 MJ。適用邊界：僅潛熱；實際需加顯熱、尾氣、設備與散熱。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Evaporated water=1000 kg; assumed effective latent heat=2.3 MJ/kg. Model Qlat=mλ gives 2300 MJ. Applicability: Latent heat only; sensible heat, exhaust, equipment and losses are additional.
steps.failure: 只算顯熱會大幅漏掉乾燥熱需求。診斷與介入：另加顯熱與熱損，避免潛熱單項被當總能源。
steps.failureEn: Sensible heat alone misses much of drying demand. Diagnostic response: Add sensible heat and losses rather than treating latent heat as total energy.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「汽化潛熱」的觀測點。比較水量收支與燃料／蒸汽能量表，列出未回收熱。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for latent-heat requirement. Compare water balance with fuel/steam energy and list unrecovered heat. knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Evaporated water=1000 kg; assumed effective latent heat=2.3 MJ/kg. Model Qlat=mλ gives 2300 MJ. Applicability: Latent heat only; sensible heat, exhaust, equipment and losses are additional.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 m:1000→1200 kg，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2300 變為 2760 MJ。用「汽化潛熱」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only m:1000→1200 kg, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2300 to 2760 MJ. Explain the direction using latent-heat requirement, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 進料與產品顯熱：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Feed and product sensible heat: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 進料與產品顯熱 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Feed and product sensible heat and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 進料、固體及設備的升溫都影響能耗，濕污泥可先用等效熱容估計。
steps.instructionEn: Feed, solids and equipment heating affect demand; use an effective heat capacity for a first estimate.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：污泥質量 m=1000 kg；cp=4 kJ/(kg·K)；ΔT=20 K。模型 Q=m cp ΔT，代入得到 80 MJ。適用邊界：顯熱近似，不含散熱、相變與容器升溫。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge mass m=1000 kg; cp=4 kJ/(kg·K); ΔT=20 K. Model Q=m cp ΔT gives 80 MJ. Applicability: Sensible-heat approximation, excluding heat losses, phase change and vessel heating.
steps.failure: 把所有物質熱容當水且不揭露假設。診斷與介入：更新進料量、含水率和溫度，再核對熱損及回收。
steps.failureEn: Assuming every heat capacity equals water without disclosure is misleading. Diagnostic response: Update feed, moisture and temperature and check heat loss/recovery.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「進料與產品顯熱」的觀測點。對照進出口溫度、質量及熱媒供應量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed and product sensible heat. Compare inlet/outlet temperatures, mass and heating-medium supply. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.textEn: Change only ΔT:20→25 K, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 80 to 100 MJ. Explain the direction using feed and product sensible heat, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.objective: 區分 熱回收溫位 的失效原因，提出能排除替代解釋的檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Heat-recovery temperature grade with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 回收熱重複抵扣兩個單元。診斷與介入：核對熱源與熱需求溫位，避免把低溫回熱全算可用。
steps.instructionEn: Crediting the same recovered heat twice exaggerates savings. Diagnostic response: Check source/demand temperature grades before counting recovered heat as usable.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：可回收熱源=400 MJ；假設回收率=0.65。模型 Qrec=Qη，代入得到 260 MJ。適用邊界：只按能量回收率，不包含溫位與換熱最小溫差限制。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Available heat=400 MJ; assumed recovery fraction=0.65. Model Qrec=Qη gives 260 MJ. Applicability: Energy-fraction estimate only; temperature grade and minimum approach are omitted.
steps.failure: 回收熱重複抵扣兩個單元。診斷與介入：核對熱源與熱需求溫位，避免把低溫回熱全算可用。
steps.failureEn: Crediting the same recovered heat twice exaggerates savings. Diagnostic response: Check source/demand temperature grades before counting recovered heat as usable.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「熱回收溫位」的觀測點。畫出冷熱物流溫度區間，確認回收熱仍有可用溫差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for heat-recovery temperature grade. Plot hot/cold temperature ranges and check usable driving temperature difference. steps.titleEn: Energy per water evaporated: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 單位蒸發能耗 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 以每公斤蒸發水比較效能，並固定進出含固率與供熱邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Compare per kilogram evaporated at matching solids fractions and heat boundaries.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：總供熱=3000 MJ；蒸發水=1000 kg。模型 SEC=Q/Mevap，代入得到 3 MJ/kg water。適用邊界：相同進出含固率與熱邊界才可比較。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Total heat supplied=3000 MJ; water evaporated=1000 kg. Model SEC=Q/Mevap gives 3 MJ/kg water. Applicability: Compare only at identical inlet/outlet solids and heat boundaries.

steps.failureEn: Per-wet-tonne comparisons across different moisture contents mislead. Diagnostic response: Measure actual evaporation and whole-system heat input at the same boundary.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「單位蒸發能耗」的觀測點。同時計量水分移除與外購、回收熱。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for energy per water evaporated. Meter water removal and imported/recovered heat simultaneously. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Dry biogas=500 m³/d; CH4 volume fraction=0.60. Model VCH4=Vgas xCH4 gives 300 m³ CH4/d. Applicability: Common dry basis and temperature/pressure; CO2 removal can raise the fraction without increasing methane quantity.
steps.failure: 濕氣量未校正即估熱值。診斷與介入：以溫壓一致的甲烷組成分析重算，確認乾濕基準。
steps.failureEn: Uncorrected wet-gas volume distorts energy. Diagnostic response: Recalculate from same-condition methane analysis and verify wet/dry basis.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「沼氣熱值邊界」的觀測點。使用氣體分析器與標準化流量計配對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。

steps.title: 凝結水與尾氣：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Condensate and exhaust: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 凝結水與尾氣 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Condensate and exhaust and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 水離開固體後進入凝結水或尾氣，仍須追蹤污染物與回流負荷。
steps.instructionEn: Removed water enters condensate/exhaust; contaminants and recycle loading still need tracking.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：入口水蒸氣負荷=20 kg/d；冷凝去除=15 kg/d。模型 Mremain=Min-Mcond，代入得到 5 kg water/d。適用邊界：水分收支不等於露點合格；還須氣壓、氣溫及含濕量。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inlet water-vapor load=20 kg/d; condensed removal=15 kg/d. Model Mremain=Min-Mcond gives 5 kg water/d. Applicability: A water balance does not prove dew-point compliance; gas pressure, temperature and humidity are needed.
steps.failure: 把蒸發當作污染物全部消除。診斷與介入：另測露點與含濕，檢查排水及下游相容性。
steps.failureEn: Evaporation is incorrectly equated with pollutant destruction. Diagnostic response: Measure dew point/moisture separately and check drainage/downstream compatibility.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「凝結水與尾氣」的觀測點。量冷凝水並以露點儀確認乾燥器出口。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。

steps.instruction: 完整方案同時列淨能源、產品品質與粉塵／熱設備防護，數值練習僅在離線模型進行。

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.

title: 消化氣淨化與利用
summary: 本課以沼氣污染物分離、甲烷回收與淨能源為主線，從乾基氣量與甲烷分率、水分與冷凝、硫化氫吸附床、矽氧烷與設備沉積進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops biogas contaminant separation, methane recovery and net energy through ten connected units, beginning with dry-gas volume and methane fraction, moisture and condensation, hydrogen-sulfide sorbent bed, siloxanes and equipment deposition. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 乾基氣量與甲烷分率：機制與觀察

steps.instruction: 先統一乾濕基、溫度與壓力，再把總沼氣換成甲烷量。
steps.instructionEn: Normalize moisture, temperature and pressure before converting biogas to methane volume.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：乾沼氣=500 m³/d；CH4 體積分率=0.60。模型 VCH4=Vgas xCH4，代入得到 300 m³ CH4/d。適用邊界：同一乾基與溫壓；CO2 去除會改變分率而不必然增加甲烷量。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Dry biogas=500 m³/d; CH4 volume fraction=0.60. Model VCH4=Vgas xCH4 gives 300 m³ CH4/d. Applicability: Common dry basis and temperature/pressure; CO2 removal can raise the fraction without increasing methane quantity.
steps.failure: 不同標準狀態的流量被直接相加。診斷與介入：以溫壓一致的甲烷組成分析重算，確認乾濕基準。

steps.instruction: 介質容量與傳質區共同影響突破，床前後分析比固定更換日數可靠。

steps.observation: 原創教學假設：介質=100 kg；假設有效容量=0.10 kg污染物/kg；負荷=0.5 kg/d。模型 tlife=Mq/L，代入得到 20 d。適用邊界：理想容量概估，未包含濕度競爭與傳質區；須以突破監測控制。

steps.title: 二氧化碳分離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Carbon-dioxide separation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 二氧化碳分離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Carbon-dioxide separation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 去除 CO2 提升甲烷比例，但不會創造新的甲烷分子。
steps.instructionEn: Removing CO2 raises methane fraction without creating methane molecules.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：乾沼氣=500 m³/d；CH4 體積分率=0.60。模型 VCH4=Vgas xCH4，代入得到 300 m³ CH4/d。適用邊界：同一乾基與溫壓；CO2 去除會改變分率而不必然增加甲烷量。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Dry biogas=500 m³/d; CH4 volume fraction=0.60. Model VCH4=Vgas xCH4 gives 300 m³ CH4/d. Applicability: Common dry basis and temperature/pressure; CO2 removal can raise the fraction without increasing methane quantity.
steps.failure: 用產品氣純度上升宣稱甲烷產量同幅增加。診斷與介入：以溫壓一致的甲烷組成分析重算，確認乾濕基準。
steps.failureEn: Higher product purity is mistaken for equal methane-production growth. Diagnostic response: Recalculate from same-condition methane analysis and verify wet/dry basis.

steps.title: 儲氣與用氣配對：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Storage and demand matching: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 儲氣與用氣配對 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Storage and demand matching and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 產氣與用氣時間不同，儲氣及安全去向決定可利用程度。
steps.instructionEn: Different generation/demand timing makes storage and safe alternative routing decisive.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：假想產氣=30、用氣=20 m³/h；時段=2 h。模型 ΔV=(Qprod-Quse)t，代入得到 20 m³ reference gas。適用邊界：同一參考溫壓下的累積氣量差；不能直接當儲氣設備實際幾何容量或容許壓力。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Hypothetical production=30, demand=20 m³/h; interval=2 h. Model ΔV=(Qprod-Quse)t gives 20 m³ reference gas. Applicability: Accumulated gas-volume difference at one reference condition; not vessel geometric capacity or permitted pressure.
steps.failure: 將日產氣全當同時可供發電。診斷與介入：逐時閉合產用氣，確認其他氣體去向與儲存參考狀態。
steps.failureEn: Daily gas total is treated as instantly available. Diagnostic response: Close hourly production/demand and confirm other gas destinations and storage reference conditions.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「儲氣與用氣配對」的觀測點。量產用氣歷線、溫壓與其他氣體去向，逐時累積收支。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for storage and demand matching. Measure production/demand traces, temperature/pressure and other destinations, then integrate hourly balances. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 發電熱值基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Generation heating-value basis: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 發電熱值基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Generation heating-value basis and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把標準化甲烷能量乘轉換效率，並避免高低熱值混用。
steps.instructionEn: Apply conversion efficiency to normalized methane energy without mixing higher/lower heating values.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：CH4=300 m³/d；假設熱值=35.8 MJ/m³；電效率=0.35。模型 Ee=V LHV η/3.6，代入得到 1044.1667 kWh/d。適用邊界：氣體須同溫壓、乾基；未扣設備寄生用電與停機。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: CH4=300 m³/d; assumed heating value=35.8 MJ/m³; electric efficiency=0.35. Model Ee=V LHV η/3.6 gives 1044.1667 kWh/d. Applicability: Gas must share temperature/pressure and dry basis; parasitic power and downtime are not deducted.
steps.failure: 效率與熱值採不同基準而虛增收益。診斷與介入：確認甲烷體積及熱值基準，分開發電、回熱與自用。
steps.failureEn: Mismatched efficiency/heating-value bases inflate benefits. Diagnostic response: Confirm methane volume/heating-value bases and separate electricity, heat and internal demand.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「發電熱值基準」的觀測點。比對標準化甲烷流量與發電機電表。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for generation heating-value basis. Compare normalized methane flow with the generator meter. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 輔機與淨能源：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 輔機與淨能源 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Auxiliaries and net energy and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 壓縮、乾燥與循環泵消耗部分回收能源，分表才能知道淨收益。
steps.instructionEn: Compression, drying and circulation consume recovered energy; submeter to determine net benefit.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：毛發電=1000 kWh/d；壓縮、乾燥與輔機=180 kWh/d。模型 Enet=Egross-Eaux，代入得到 820 kWh/d。適用邊界：同一系統邊界；熱回收收益不可重複算入電量。

steps.failure: 用毛發電替代可輸出淨電。診斷與介入：核對每個附屬電表與能源邊界，分列熱能和電能。

steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for auxiliaries and net energy. Submeter each auxiliary and report usable waste heat separately. title: 污水曝氣能耗最佳化
summary: 本課以溶氧需求、傳質效率與鼓風系統最佳化為主線，從能耗量測邊界、硝化氧需求盤點、污水修正係數、溶氧驅動差進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops oxygen demand, transfer efficiency and blower optimization through ten connected units, beginning with energy-metering boundary, nitrification oxygen demand, wastewater correction factor, oxygen driving difference. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 硝化氧需求盤點：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Nitrification oxygen demand: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 硝化氧需求盤點 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Nitrification oxygen demand and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氨氮轉化需氧與碳氧化需氧分列，避免把出水惡化當需求降低。
steps.instructionEn: Separate nitrification/carbon demands and do not mistake degraded effluent for lower demand.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：硝化 NH4-N=40 kg/d；理論 O2/N=4.57。模型 O2=4.57×N，代入得到 182.8 kg O2/d。適用邊界：完全氧化至硝酸鹽的理論需氧；異營與內源耗氧另外列。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Nitrified NH4-N=40 kg/d; theoretical O2/N=4.57. Model O2=4.57×N gives 182.8 kg O2/d. Applicability: Theoretical complete nitrification demand; heterotrophic and endogenous oxygen demand are separate.
steps.failure: 省電同時氨氮上升卻未報告。診斷與介入：分列有機與硝化需氧，用氮轉化量交叉核對。
steps.failureEn: Energy savings are reported while ammonium rises. Diagnostic response: Separate carbonaceous/nitrification demand and cross-check N conversion.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「硝化氧需求盤點」的觀測點。把氨氮轉化量與耗氧率作質量配對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for nitrification oxygen demand. Pair ammonium conversion with oxygen-uptake measurements. steps.title: 溶氧驅動差：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Oxygen driving difference: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 溶氧驅動差 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Oxygen driving difference and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: DO 過高減小飽和濃度與水中濃度差，會降低同條件的傳質驅動力。
steps.instructionEn: Excess DO reduces the saturation-to-liquid difference and the transfer driving force.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：kLa=4 h⁻¹；C*=8 mg/L；C=2 mg/L；V=1000 m³。模型 OTR=kLa(C*-C)V/1000，代入得到 24 kg O2/h。適用邊界：等溫、均勻混合的簡化傳質；kLa 已假設為污水條件。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: kLa=4 h⁻¹; C*=8 mg/L; C=2 mg/L; V=1000 m³. Model OTR=kLa(C*-C)V/1000 gives 24 kg O2/h. Applicability: Isothermal mixed-tank transfer; kLa is assumed to represent wastewater conditions.
steps.failure: 把高 DO 當作唯一良好控制指標。診斷與介入：比對不同位置 DO 與耗氧率，區分需求改變和傳氧退化。
steps.failureEn: High DO is treated as the only good-control indicator. Diagnostic response: Compare spatial DO and oxygen uptake to separate demand changes from transfer deterioration.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「溶氧驅動差」的觀測點。比對溶氧剖面、耗氧率與尾氣推估。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for oxygen driving difference. Compare DO profiles, oxygen-uptake rate and off-gas estimates. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 空氣需求：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Air requirement: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 空氣需求 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Air requirement and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 氧需求要經含氧量及傳移效率換算成氣量，不能直接把公斤當立方米。
steps.instructionEn: Convert oxygen mass through air oxygen content and transfer efficiency to air volume.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：需轉移 O2=24 kg/h；空氣含氧=0.28 kg/m³；轉移效率=0.15。模型 Qair=O2/(cO2η)，代入得到 571.42857 m³ air/h。適用邊界：空氣體積須對應所選標準狀態；效率是假設，非製造商保證。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Transferred O2=24 kg/h; oxygen in air=0.28 kg/m³; transfer efficiency=0.15. Model Qair=O2/(cO2η) gives 571.42857 m³ air/h. Applicability: Air volume uses the specified reference condition; efficiency is assumed, not manufacturer-guaranteed.
steps.failure: 空氣標準狀態沒有一致化。診斷與介入：更新氧需求與實測傳氧效率，核對配氣均勻性。
steps.failureEn: Air reference conditions are not harmonized. Diagnostic response: Update oxygen demand/measured transfer efficiency and check air distribution.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「空氣需求」的觀測點。以尾氣量測校正轉移效率，再比較鼓風機流量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for air requirement. Calibrate transfer efficiency using off-gas measurements and compare blower flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 轉氧比能率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Oxygen-transfer energy efficiency: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 轉氧比能率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Oxygen-transfer energy efficiency and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 比較單位電力真正轉入的氧，並將控制效果與設備效率分開。
steps.instructionEn: Compare oxygen actually transferred per electricity and separate control effects from equipment efficiency.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：實際轉氧=480 kg O2/d；用電=400 kWh/d。模型 SAE=O2/E，代入得到 1.2 kg O2/kWh。適用邊界：現場比能率須共同量測與水質約束，不能只看清水額定值。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Actual oxygen transfer=480 kg O2/d; electricity=400 kWh/d. Model SAE=O2/E gives 1.2 kg O2/kWh. Applicability: Field efficiency needs matched measurements and water-quality constraints, not clean-water ratings alone.
steps.failure: 只看鼓風量而沒有轉氧證據。診斷與介入：把氧轉移估算和電力邊界對齊，確認出水品質。
steps.failureEn: Airflow is compared without oxygen-transfer evidence. Diagnostic response: Align oxygen-transfer/electricity boundaries and verify effluent quality.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「轉氧比能率」的觀測點。把轉氧、負荷與用電放入同一時間窗。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for oxygen-transfer energy efficiency. Place oxygen transfer, loading and electricity in the same interval. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.titleEn: Zonal recycle and mixing: Mechanism and observation

steps.instruction: 回流攜氧可侵入缺氧段；降低曝氣也不能犧牲必要的混合。
steps.instructionEn: Recycle oxygen can enter anoxic zones; reduced aeration must not sacrifice necessary mixing.

steps.objective: 辨識 節能驗收 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Energy-saving acceptance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 驗收同時比較出水、污泥與能源，使用可重播的前後相近負荷時段。
steps.instructionEn: Accept savings using comparable replayable periods and checking effluent, sludge and energy.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：電力 E=960 kWh/d；處理量 Q=3000 m³/d。模型 SEC=E/Q，代入得到 0.32 kWh/m³。適用邊界：同一系統邊界與同一日；需同時滿足出流水品質。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Electricity E=960 kWh/d; flow Q=3000 m³/d. Model SEC=E/Q gives 0.32 kWh/m³. Applicability: Use identical system boundaries and days; effluent quality must also be satisfied.
steps.failure: 前後水量不同使每度電比較失真。診斷與介入：配對相同流量與出水品質再比較能耗，列出附屬設備。
steps.failureEn: Different before/after flows distort electricity comparisons. Diagnostic response: Compare energy at matched flow/quality and list auxiliary equipment.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「節能驗收」的觀測點。同步讀取電表、流量計與水質趨勢。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for energy-saving acceptance. Synchronize electricity, flow and water-quality trends. scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：電力 E=960 kWh/d；處理量 Q=3000 m³/d。模型 SEC=E/Q，代入得到 0.32 kWh/m³。適用邊界：同一系統邊界與同一日；需同時滿足出流水品質。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Electricity E=960 kWh/d; flow Q=3000 m³/d. Model SEC=E/Q gives 0.32 kWh/m³. Applicability: Use identical system boundaries and days; effluent quality must also be satisfied.

title: 初級沉澱池設計
summary: 本課以沉降、水力分配與初沉污泥收支為主線，從懸浮固體進流、沉降速度與池深、表面溢流率、有效停留與短流進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops settling, flow distribution and primary-sludge balance through ten connected units, beginning with influent suspended-solids loading, settling velocity and depth, surface overflow rate, effective residence and bypass. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 懸浮固體進流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Influent suspended-solids loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 懸浮固體進流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Influent suspended-solids loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 初沉池去除可沉固體，負荷需以 TSS、沉降性與流量共同界定。
steps.instructionEn: Primary clarification targets settleable solids; define loading with TSS, settleability and flow.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；C=180 mg/L。模型 L=QC/1000，代入得到 360 kg/d。適用邊界：穩定流量與流量加權濃度；瞬時樣本不代表整日。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; C=180 mg/L. Model L=QC/1000 gives 360 kg/d. Applicability: Steady flow and flow-weighted concentration; a grab sample does not represent a day.
steps.failure: 只看濁度替代固體質量。診斷與介入：先回查濃度基準與流量加權採樣，再重算負荷。
steps.failureEn: Turbidity is used as a substitute for solids mass. Diagnostic response: First check the concentration basis and flow-weighted sampling, then recalculate loading.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「懸浮固體進流」的觀測點。比對累積流量計與流量比例混合樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for influent suspended-solids loading. Compare the totalizing flowmeter with a flow-proportional composite sample. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.textEn: Inlet dissipation, baffles and outlets influence bypass; tracing reveals more than V/Q alone.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 Q:3000→3600 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 12 變為 10 h。用「有效停留與短流」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Q:3000→3600 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 12 to 10 h. Explain the direction using effective residence and bypass, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 出水堰分配：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Effluent-weir distribution: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 出水堰分配 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Effluent-weir distribution and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 堰頂標高與局部負荷影響均勻出流，維護不平會吸走局部絮體。
steps.instructionEn: Weir level and local loading control distribution; uneven crests draw local floc.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=3000 m³/d；堰長=40 m。模型 WL=Q/Lw，代入得到 75 m³/(m·d)。適用邊界：平均堰負荷不反映堰板不平與局部流量偏置。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=3000 m³/d; weir length=40 m. Model WL=Q/Lw gives 75 m³/(m·d). Applicability: Mean weir loading does not reveal uneven weirs or local flow bias.
steps.failure: 長堰未調平仍發生偏流。診斷與介入：對照堰高程與沿堰流量，查局部偏流及附著物。
steps.failureEn: A long unlevel weir still causes maldistribution. Diagnostic response: Compare weir elevation/local flow and inspect uneven flow/deposits.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「出水堰分配」的觀測點。逐段檢查堰頂高程與出流分布。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effluent-weir distribution. Check weir crest elevation and discharge distribution segment by segment. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=3000 m³/d; weir length=40 m. Model WL=Q/Lw gives 75 m³/(m·d). Applicability: Mean weir loading does not reveal uneven weirs or local flow bias.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 Q:3000→4200 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 75 變為 105 m³/(m·d)。用「出水堰分配」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Q:3000→4200 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 75 to 105 m³/(m·d). Explain the direction using effluent-weir distribution, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 有機物去除與後段：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Organic removal and downstream demand: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 有機物去除與後段 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Organic removal and downstream demand and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 初沉去除有機物可減少曝氣負荷，也可能減少後段反硝化碳。
steps.instructionEn: Primary organic removal can reduce aeration demand and downstream denitrification carbon.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Cin=100 mg/L；Cout=20 mg/L。模型 η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin，代入得到 0.8 fraction。適用邊界：濃度去除率僅在進出流量相等時等於質量去除率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Cin=100 mg/L; Cout=20 mg/L. Model η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin gives 0.8 fraction. Applicability: Concentration removal equals mass removal only for equal inlet/outlet flow.
steps.failure: 只追求最大初沉去除而忽略後段需要。診斷與介入：配對進出水流量及分析基準，另外確認轉化產物。
steps.failureEn: Maximizing primary removal ignores downstream needs. Diagnostic response: Match inlet/outlet flow and analysis bases and check transformation products separately.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「有機物去除與後段」的觀測點。用相同分析方法與流量加權樣本，另列流量差異。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for organic removal and downstream demand. Use matching methods and flow-weighted samples and report any flow difference. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
