steps.instruction: 排泥需用固體質量閉合，濃度與體積變動不能單獨判讀。
steps.instructionEn: Close sludge removal on a solids-mass basis; concentration and volume alone are insufficient.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.

steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「污泥排出基準」的觀測點。由體積、密度與烘乾固體三個獨立量測建質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge-withdrawal basis. Build mass from independent volume, density and oven-dry solids measurements. steps.objective: 辨識 污泥與上清混合 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sludge and supernatant mixing and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 回流水的溶解有機物與固體須重新納入進流，不可當作無負荷清水。
steps.instructionEn: Return liquids add dissolved organics/solids and are not load-free water.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q1=1000、Q2=500 m³/d；C1=20、C2=80 mg/L。模型 Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)，代入得到 40 mg/L。適用邊界：無反應、同一成分與相同濃度基準；不可直接套用 pH。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q1=1000, Q2=500 m³/d; C1=20, C2=80 mg/L. Model Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2) gives 40 mg/L. Applicability: No reaction and the same species/concentration basis; do not directly average pH this way.
steps.failure: 旁流接回入口但未納入採樣。診斷與介入：核對兩股流量及同成分分析，避免以簡單平均混合。
steps.failureEn: Returned sidestreams are excluded from sampling. Diagnostic response: Check both flows and same-species analyses rather than arithmetic averaging.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「污泥與上清混合」的觀測點。量兩股流量與成分，再在混合充分的位置採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge and supernatant mixing. Measure both flows and concentrations, then sample after adequate mixing. scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；C=180 mg/L。模型 L=QC/1000，代入得到 360 kg/d。適用邊界：穩定流量與流量加權濃度；瞬時樣本不代表整日。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; C=180 mg/L. Model L=QC/1000 gives 360 kg/d. Applicability: Steady flow and flow-weighted concentration; a grab sample does not represent a day.

title: 二級沉澱池污泥控制
summary: 本課以二沉池固體通量、泥毯與回排泥為主線，從混合液固體進入、沉降指標與曲線、回流濃度平衡、水力與固體雙限制進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops secondary-clarifier solids flux, blanket and sludge return/wasting through ten connected units, beginning with mixed-liquor solids input, settleability and curves, return-sludge concentration balance, hydraulic and solids constraints. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 混合液固體進入：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mixed-liquor solids input: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 混合液固體進入 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mixed-liquor solids input and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 二沉池處理混合液與回流循環的固體通量，不能只看出流水量。
steps.instructionEn: Secondary clarification handles mixed-liquor/recycle solids flux, not effluent flow alone.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q+Qr=5000 m³/d；X=3 kg/m³；A=200 m²。模型 SLR=(Q+Qr)X/A，代入得到 75 kg solids/(m²·d)。適用邊界：固體表面負荷須搭配沉降曲線，不能只看水力溢流率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q+Qr=5000 m³/d; X=3 kg/m³; A=200 m². Model SLR=(Q+Qr)X/A gives 75 kg solids/(m²·d). Applicability: Solids loading requires a settling curve, not only hydraulic overflow rate.
steps.failure: 漏算回流造成固體負荷低估。診斷與介入：把回流及混合液濃度都列入，查分池負荷不均。
steps.failureEn: Omitting recycle understates solids loading. Diagnostic response: Include recycle and mixed-liquor concentration and check cell-load imbalance.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「混合液固體進入」的觀測點。量混合液固體與回流，並畫固體通量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for mixed-liquor solids input. Measure mixed-liquor solids/recycle and construct a solids-flux plot. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 沉降指標與曲線：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Settleability and curves: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 沉降指標與曲線 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Settleability and curves and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: SVI 是批次指標，須搭配完整沉降曲線與濃度，避免單數值定性。
steps.instructionEn: SVI is a batch indicator; pair it with a full curve and concentration rather than labeling from one number.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：30 min 沉降體積=300 mL/L；MLSS=3 g/L。模型 SVI=V30/X，代入得到 100 mL/g。適用邊界：單一批次沉降指標，受濃度、絮體與稀釋方法影響。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: 30-minute settled volume=300 mL/L; MLSS=3 g/L. Model SVI=V30/X gives 100 mL/g. Applicability: Batch settleability indicator affected by concentration, floc and dilution method.
steps.failure: 高濃度阻礙沉降被錯認為絲狀菌膨化。診斷與介入：補做完整沉降曲線及顯微觀察，不由 SVI 單點定性。
steps.failureEn: Concentration-hindered settling is mistaken for filamentous bulking. Diagnostic response: Add full settling curves/microscopy rather than diagnosing from one SVI value.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「沉降指標與曲線」的觀測點。記錄量筒、溫度、沉降曲線與稀釋程序。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for settleability and curves. Record cylinder, temperature, settling curve and dilution procedure. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 回流濃度平衡：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Return-sludge concentration balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 回流濃度平衡 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Return-sludge concentration balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 回流量與回流濃度共同維持菌體循環，池底庫存仍需獨立追蹤。
steps.instructionEn: Return flow and concentration maintain biomass cycling while blanket inventory needs separate tracking.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：混合液 X=3 kg/m³；回流 XR=8 kg/m³。模型 R=X/(XR-X)，代入得到 0.6 ratio。適用邊界：簡化穩態沉澱池平衡，忽略排泥、出流水固體與庫存變化。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Mixed liquor X=3 kg/m³; return sludge XR=8 kg/m³. Model R=X/(XR-X) gives 0.6 ratio. Applicability: Simplified steady clarifier balance, omitting wasting, effluent solids and storage changes.
steps.failure: 只增加回流而未看沉澱能力。診斷與介入：將回流濃度、泥毯及出水固體一起檢查。
steps.failureEn: Increasing recycle without checking settling capacity fails. Diagnostic response: Check return concentration, blanket and effluent solids together.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「回流濃度平衡」的觀測點。以池底庫存與出流固體檢查簡化假設。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for return-sludge concentration balance. Check assumptions against blanket inventory and effluent solids. steps.instruction: 泥毯上升可能代表固體進入大於移出，需把高度轉成體積及質量趨勢。

steps.title: 回流與排泥分工：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Return versus wasting: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 回流與排泥分工 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Return versus wasting and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 回流重分配菌體，排泥改變全系統固體年齡，兩種操作不可互換。
steps.instructionEn: Return redistributes biomass; wasting changes system solids age, so the two are not interchangeable.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：固體庫存 MX=4500 kg；排泥=180 kg/d；出流水固體=20 kg/d。模型 SRT=MX/(W+E)，代入得到 22.5 d。適用邊界：全系統固體收支的準穩態估計；回流不是離開系統的排泥。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Solids inventory MX=4500 kg; wasting=180 kg/d; effluent solids=20 kg/d. Model SRT=MX/(W+E) gives 22.5 d. Applicability: Quasi-steady whole-system solids balance; return sludge is not a solids exit.
steps.failure: 用回流量替代排泥質量計算污泥齡。診斷與介入：用實際排出乾固體修正 SRT，分開回流與離開系統的流股。
steps.failureEn: Recycle volume substitutes for wasted mass in SRT. Diagnostic response: Correct SRT with actual exported dry solids, separating recycle from system exits.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「回流與排泥分工」的觀測點。從排泥流量、含固率與出流水 TSS 各算質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for return versus wasting. Calculate masses independently from wasting flow, solids fraction and effluent TSS. steps.objective: 重算 回流與排泥分工 的教學算例，核對單位與適用條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Recalculate the teaching example for Return versus wasting and verify units and assumptions.
steps.instruction: 原創教學假設：固體庫存 MX=4500 kg；排泥=180 kg/d；出流水固體=20 kg/d。模型 SRT=MX/(W+E)，代入得到 22.5 d。適用邊界：全系統固體收支的準穩態估計；回流不是離開系統的排泥。
steps.instructionEn: Original teaching assumptions: Solids inventory MX=4500 kg; wasting=180 kg/d; effluent solids=20 kg/d. Model SRT=MX/(W+E) gives 22.5 d. Applicability: Quasi-steady whole-system solids balance; return sludge is not a solids exit.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：固體庫存 MX=4500 kg；排泥=180 kg/d；出流水固體=20 kg/d。模型 SRT=MX/(W+E)，代入得到 22.5 d。適用邊界：全系統固體收支的準穩態估計；回流不是離開系統的排泥。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Solids inventory MX=4500 kg; wasting=180 kg/d; effluent solids=20 kg/d. Model SRT=MX/(W+E) gives 22.5 d. Applicability: Quasi-steady whole-system solids balance; return sludge is not a solids exit.
steps.failure: 用回流量替代排泥質量計算污泥齡。診斷與介入：用實際排出乾固體修正 SRT，分開回流與離開系統的流股。
steps.failureEn: Recycle volume substitutes for wasted mass in SRT. Diagnostic response: Correct SRT with actual exported dry solids, separating recycle from system exits.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「回流與排泥分工」的觀測點。從排泥流量、含固率與出流水 TSS 各算質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for return versus wasting. Calculate masses independently from wasting flow, solids fraction and effluent TSS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 W:180→230 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 22.5 變為 18 d。用「回流與排泥分工」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only W:180→230 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 22.5 to 18 d. Explain the direction using return versus wasting, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 出水顆粒攜磷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Effluent solids carrying phosphorus: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 出水顆粒攜磷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Effluent solids carrying phosphorus and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 固體流失同時攜帶有機物與磷，水相反應正常仍可能出水不良。
steps.instructionEn: Escaping solids carry organics/P even when aqueous reactions work well.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：出流水 TSS=10 mg/L；固體含磷率=0.04。模型 Ppart=TSS fP，代入得到 0.4 mg P/L。適用邊界：把固體組成當固定的教學近似；還須加上溶解磷。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Effluent TSS=10 mg/L; solids P fraction=0.04. Model Ppart=TSS fP gives 0.4 mg P/L. Applicability: Assumes constant solids composition; dissolved P must also be included.
steps.failure: 只查正磷酸鹽忽略 TSS。診斷與介入：比較過濾前後磷與 TSS，優先診斷固體逃逸。
steps.failureEn: Orthophosphate-only analysis misses TSS-related P. Diagnostic response: Compare filtered/unfiltered P and TSS, first diagnosing solids escape.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「出水顆粒攜磷」的觀測點。比較過濾前後總磷與 TSS。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effluent solids carrying phosphorus. Compare filtered/unfiltered phosphorus with TSS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.textEn: Change only TSS:10→15 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.4 to 0.6 mg P/L. Explain the direction using effluent solids carrying phosphorus, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 出水堰及偏流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Weirs and uneven flow: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 出水堰及偏流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Weirs and uneven flow and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 均勻溢流有助減少局部高流速，堰上附著與高程誤差都需檢查。

steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=3000 m³/d；堰長=40 m。模型 WL=Q/Lw，代入得到 75 m³/(m·d)。適用邊界：平均堰負荷不反映堰板不平與局部流量偏置。

steps.failureEn: Surface cleaning overlooks weir distribution. Diagnostic response: Compare weir elevation/local flow and inspect uneven flow/deposits.

steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for weirs and uneven flow. Check weir crest elevation and discharge distribution segment by segment. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 雨天增流重播：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Wet-weather replay: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 雨天增流重播 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Wet-weather replay and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在同一固體濃度下增加流量，檢查泥毯、通量及出水峰值。
steps.instructionEn: Increase flow at fixed solids concentration and inspect blanket, flux and effluent peaks.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：峰流=6000 m³/d；平均流=3000 m³/d。模型 PF=Qpeak/Qmean，代入得到 2 ratio。適用邊界：平均、瞬時峰與設計事件尺度須標明，不能用日平均代替尖峰。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Peak flow=6000 m³/d; mean flow=3000 m³/d. Model PF=Qpeak/Qmean gives 2 ratio. Applicability: State averaging and event scales; a daily mean cannot replace a short-term peak.
steps.failure: 只考慮平均固體濃度而漏掉瞬時流量。診斷與介入：用實際峰值歷線重播，查瞬時水位及下游能力。
steps.failureEn: Average solids obscure instantaneous flow effects. Diagnostic response: Replay actual peak hydrographs and check instantaneous levels/downstream capacity.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「雨天增流重播」的觀測點。比較分鐘流量序列與每日累積水量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for wet-weather replay. Compare minute-scale flow with daily total volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：Q+Qr=5000 m³/d；X=3 kg/m³；A=200 m²。模型 SLR=(Q+Qr)X/A，代入得到 75 kg solids/(m²·d)。適用邊界：固體表面負荷須搭配沉降曲線，不能只看水力溢流率。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q+Qr=5000 m³/d; X=3 kg/m³; A=200 m². Model SLR=(Q+Qr)X/A gives 75 kg solids/(m²·d). Applicability: Solids loading requires a settling curve, not only hydraulic overflow rate.

title: 雨污合流溢流截流
summary: 本課以降雨入流、截流調蓄與事件質量為主線，從雨污合流邊界、集水面積與雨量、截流與儲槽收支、峰值與事件時間進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops rain inflow, interception, storage and event mass through ten connected units, beginning with combined-sewer boundary, catchment and rainfall, interception and storage balance, peak and event timescale. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 雨污合流邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Combined-sewer boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 雨污合流邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Combined-sewer boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 分開旱天污水與降雨逕流，才可辨識截流、儲存及處理的共同限制。
steps.instructionEn: Separate dry-weather wastewater and runoff to identify interception, storage and treatment constraints.

steps.title: 截流與儲槽收支：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Interception and storage balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 截流與儲槽收支 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Interception and storage balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 累積進出流量差決定儲量，截流增加也受下游處理限制。
steps.instructionEn: Accumulated inflow-outflow difference sets storage; interception remains constrained downstream.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Qin=0.8 m³/s；Qout=0.5 m³/s；持續=1800 s。模型 ΔV=(Qin-Qout)t，代入得到 540 m³。適用邊界：矩形入流事件與固定出流；真實事件須逐時積分。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Qin=0.8 m³/s; Qout=0.5 m³/s; duration=1800 s. Model ΔV=(Qin-Qout)t gives 540 m³. Applicability: Rectangular inflow event and fixed discharge; real events require time integration.
steps.failure: 截流管加大但下游處理無法承接。診斷與介入：累積量測進出流量並核對水位，列入沉積占容。
steps.failureEn: Larger interception overwhelms downstream treatment. Diagnostic response: Integrate measured flows, check level and account for sediment volume.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「截流與儲槽收支」的觀測點。用流量歷線積分並對照水位容積曲線。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for interception and storage balance. Integrate hydrographs and compare with the stage-volume curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 峰值與事件時間：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Peak and event timescale: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 峰值與事件時間 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Peak and event timescale and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 短時峰可能超過管渠與泵能力，即使一天總量仍有餘裕。
steps.instructionEn: Brief peaks can exceed sewer/pump capacity despite spare daily volume.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：峰流=6000 m³/d；平均流=3000 m³/d。模型 PF=Qpeak/Qmean，代入得到 2 ratio。適用邊界：平均、瞬時峰與設計事件尺度須標明，不能用日平均代替尖峰。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Peak flow=6000 m³/d; mean flow=3000 m³/d. Model PF=Qpeak/Qmean gives 2 ratio. Applicability: State averaging and event scales; a daily mean cannot replace a short-term peak.
steps.failure: 日平均掩蓋短時間溢流。診斷與介入：用實際峰值歷線重播，查瞬時水位及下游能力。
steps.failureEn: Daily averaging hides brief overflows. Diagnostic response: Replay actual peak hydrographs and check instantaneous levels/downstream capacity.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「峰值與事件時間」的觀測點。比較分鐘流量序列與每日累積水量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for peak and event timescale. Compare minute-scale flow with daily total volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 污染初期與採樣：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: First-flush behavior and sampling: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污染初期與採樣 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of First-flush behavior and sampling and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 初期沖刷需由時間序列驗證，不可假設每個事件都相同。
steps.instructionEn: Verify first-flush behavior from time series rather than assuming it for every event.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：事件排放體積=500 m³；流量加權 C=60 mg/L。模型 M=VC/1000，代入得到 30 kg/event。適用邊界：單次事件質量，不等於年度負荷或生態風險。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Event discharge=500 m³; flow-weighted C=60 mg/L. Model M=VC/1000 gives 30 kg/event. Applicability: One-event mass, not an annual load or ecological-risk result.
steps.failure: 只有雨後樣本漏掉污染尖峰。診斷與介入：以事件時序流量加權採樣，保留未採到的尖峰不確定度。
steps.failureEn: Post-storm-only samples miss pollutant peaks. Diagnostic response: Use event flow-weighted sampling and retain uncertainty from unsampled peaks.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「污染初期與採樣」的觀測點。以多時點採樣配對流量，估計未採到尖峰的誤差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for first-flush behavior and sampling. Pair multi-time sampling with flow and estimate missed-peak uncertainty. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.instruction: 調蓄降低流速也會沉積固體，有效儲量隨沉積而減少。
steps.instructionEn: Storage slows flow and deposits solids, reducing usable volume.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：粒子沉速=1.2 m/h；池深=3 m。模型 ts=H/vs，代入得到 2.5 h。適用邊界：單一離散粒子示例；實際絮凝與阻礙沉降不服從固定沉速。

steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「固體沉積與清理」的觀測點。用沉降柱畫界面高度與時間，不以單點判定。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。

steps.instruction: 以溢流體積及流量加權濃度算事件負荷，事件數減少不必然等於質量等比減少。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate event load from volume and weighted concentration; fewer events need not mean proportional mass reduction.

steps.failure: 只以事件次數宣稱全部污染減幅。診斷與介入：以事件時序流量加權採樣，保留未採到的尖峰不確定度。
steps.failureEn: Event counts alone are used to claim mass reduction. Diagnostic response: Use event flow-weighted sampling and retain uncertainty from unsampled peaks.

steps.objective: 區分 聯合驗證與維護 的失效原因，提出能排除替代解釋的檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Integrated validation and maintenance with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 儲量差額被當作自動去污。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
steps.instructionEn: Unclosed storage is mistaken for pollutant treatment. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：進入=15、出流水=2、排泥=12 kg/d。模型 ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge，代入得到 1 kg/d。適用邊界：殘差可能來自儲存、漏算旁流與量測誤差，不能自動當作反應。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Input=15, effluent=2, sludge=12 kg/d. Model ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge gives 1 kg/d. Applicability: Residual can reflect storage, omitted side streams or measurement error, not automatically a reaction.
steps.failure: 儲量差額被當作自動去污。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
steps.failureEn: Unclosed storage is mistaken for pollutant treatment. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「聯合驗證與維護」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for integrated validation and maintenance. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 聯合驗證與維護

knowledge.textEn: Unclosed storage is mistaken for pollutant treatment. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1 變為 0.5 kg/d。用「聯合驗證與維護」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1 to 0.5 kg/d. Explain the direction using integrated validation and maintenance, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：Q1=1000、Q2=500 m³/d；C1=20、C2=80 mg/L。模型 Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)，代入得到 40 mg/L。適用邊界：無反應、同一成分與相同濃度基準；不可直接套用 pH。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q1=1000, Q2=500 m³/d; C1=20, C2=80 mg/L. Model Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2) gives 40 mg/L. Applicability: No reaction and the same species/concentration basis; do not directly average pH this way.

title: 電透析除鹽系統
summary: 以「離子遷移、極化與淡濃水收支」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow ion transport, polarization and dilute/concentrate balances through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 定義除鹽負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Define the desalination load: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 定義除鹽負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Define the desalination load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先把流量和鹽濃度轉成相同時間基準的質量流率；導電度只是在離子組成固定時的替代量。
steps.instructionEn: Convert flow and salt concentration into a mass rate on one time basis; conductivity is a surrogate only for a stable ionic composition.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：Q=20 m3/h; C=1.5 kg/m3; m=QC；計算 20*1.5 = 30 kg/h。適用限制：穩態且忽略密度改變。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: Q=20 m3/h; C=1.5 kg/m3; m=QC; calculation 20*1.5 = 30 kg/h. Applicability: Steady state with negligible density change.
steps.failure: 只比較導電度會掩蓋流量增加造成的鹽負荷上升。
steps.failureEn: Conductivity alone hides a salt-load increase caused by higher flow.
steps.check: 改變流量而固定鹽濃度，核對質量流率斜率。
steps.checkEn: Vary flow at fixed salinity and check the mass-rate slope.

steps.instruction: 膜選擇性和電流效率把電荷流轉成有效離子輸送；以當量而非總離子莫耳直接計數。
steps.instructionEn: Membrane selectivity and current efficiency convert charge into useful ionic transport; count charge equivalents rather than unweighted ion moles.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：n_eq=eta I t/F; eta=0.9; I=10 A; t=3600 s; F=96485 C/mol；計算 0.9*10*3600/96485 = 0.335803 mol-equivalent。適用限制：單一膜對等效量，不乘未定義的膜數。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: n_eq=eta I t/F; eta=0.9; I=10 A; t=3600 s; F=96485 C/mol; calculation 0.9*10*3600/96485 = 0.335803 mol-equivalent. Applicability: Equivalent transfer for one cell pair; no undefined cell-count multiplier.
steps.failure: 把二價離子當成一價會低估所需電荷。
steps.failureEn: Treating divalent ions as monovalent underestimates charge demand.
steps.check: 改變電流並量測淡濃水離子收支，以反算效率。
steps.checkEn: Vary current and use dilute/concentrate ionic balances to infer efficiency.

steps.instruction: 總電流需除以有效膜面積；邊框、遮蔽與流道分布會讓局部電流密度高於平均。
steps.instructionEn: Divide current by active membrane area; frames, masking and flow maldistribution can make local density exceed its average.

steps.check: 把有效面積減少10%，繪出平均電流密度變化。
steps.checkEn: Reduce active area by ten percent and plot mean current density.

steps.titleEn: Water recovery and concentrate: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水回收率與濃水 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Water recovery and concentrate and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 回收率提高會把殘餘鹽分集中到較少濃水；產水品質和濃水處置必須同時檢核。
steps.instructionEn: Higher recovery concentrates residual salt into less brine; check product quality and concentrate handling together.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：Qc=Qf-Qp; Qf=10; Qp=7.5 m3/h；計算 10-7.5 = 2.5 m3/h。適用限制：不考慮滲透水遷移與採樣損失的體積收支。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: Qc=Qf-Qp; Qf=10; Qp=7.5 m3/h; calculation 10-7.5 = 2.5 m3/h. Applicability: Volume balance neglecting osmotic transfer and sample losses.
steps.failure: 只報回收率可能隱藏濃水量減少後的結垢風險。
steps.failureEn: Recovery alone hides scaling risk as concentrate volume falls.
steps.check: 把產水量由7.5改成8，重算濃水與鹽濃度。
steps.checkEn: Raise product flow from7.5 to8 and recalculate concentrate flow and salinity.

steps.title: 流道泵浦功率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Channel pumping power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 流道泵浦功率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Channel pumping power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 增加流速可降低邊界層厚度，卻提高泵功；需比較總能耗而非只看堆電耗。
steps.instructionEn: Higher velocity can thin the boundary layer while increasing pumping demand; compare total rather than stack-only energy.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：P=DeltaP Q/eta; DeltaP=50000 Pa; Q=0.002 m3/s; eta=0.65；計算 50000*0.002/0.65 = 153.846 W。適用限制：不可壓水流的泵輸入功率；eta為整體電至水效率。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: P=DeltaP Q/eta; DeltaP=50000 Pa; Q=0.002 m3/s; eta=0.65; calculation 50000*0.002/0.65 = 153.846 W. Applicability: Pump input power for incompressible water; eta is overall wire-to-water efficiency.
steps.failure: 泵效率和堆效率混為一談會低估總耗電。
steps.failureEn: Confusing pump and stack efficiencies understates total electricity.
steps.check: 把流量加倍，另行量測壓差而非假設不變。
steps.checkEn: Double flow and measure pressure drop rather than assuming it stays fixed.

steps.title: 單位對數去除電耗：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Electrical energy per order: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 單位對數去除電耗 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Electrical energy per order and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: EEO把光源耗能除以處理水量與對數去除，用於固定邊界下比較；不能忽略泵與藥劑。
steps.instructionEn: EEO normalizes light-source energy by volume and logarithmic removal for a fixed boundary; it does not erase pumping or reagent costs.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：EEO=P t/[V log10(C0/C)]; P=2 kW;t=0.5 h;V=1 m3;ratio=10；計算 2*0.5/(1*log10(10)) = 1 kWh/m3/order。適用限制：批次近似，僅所列電力邊界。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: EEO=P t/[V log10(C0/C)]; P=2 kW;t=0.5 h;V=1 m3;ratio=10; calculation 2*0.5/(1*log10(10)) = 1 kWh/m3/order. Applicability: Batch approximation with only the stated electricity boundary.
steps.failure: 把照明效率與全系統效率混同會低報耗能。
steps.failureEn: Equating lamp efficiency with system efficiency understates energy.
steps.check: 比較相同去除倍數下不同處理容積的EEO。
steps.checkEn: Compare EEO at equal removal ratio for different treated volumes.

summary: 以「獨立障壁、量測界限與事件追溯」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow independent barriers, measurement limits and event traceability through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

steps.instruction: LRV是進出濃度比的常用對數；必須有可比較樣品和分析範圍。
steps.instructionEn: LRV is the base-ten logarithm of the inlet/outlet ratio; samples and analytical ranges must be comparable.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：LRV=log10(Cin/Cout); Cin=10000; Cout=10 counts/L；計算 log10(10000/10) = 3 log10。適用限制：同一可量測指標與流態。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: LRV=log10(Cin/Cout); Cin=10000; Cout=10 counts/L; calculation log10(10000/10) = 3 log10. Applicability: Same measurable indicator and flow regime.
steps.failure: 把百分比去除相加會錯估多障壁效果。
steps.failureEn: Adding percentage removals misestimates multiple barriers.
steps.check: 把出水濃度增加十倍並比較LRV下降。
steps.checkEn: Increase outlet concentration tenfold and compare the LRV reduction.

title: 水質線上感測校正
summary: 以「從校正標準到可追溯水質時序」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow from calibration standards to traceable water-quality series through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 位置與樣品代表性：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Location and sample representativeness: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 位置與樣品代表性 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Location and sample representativeness and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 感測器讀到的是局部水團；流速、分層和旁流管延遲會改變代表性。
steps.instructionEn: The sensor measures a local parcel; velocity, stratification and bypass delay affect representativeness.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：delay=V/Q; V=2 L; Q=0.5 L/min；計算 2/0.5 = 4 min。適用限制：理想旁流平均時間。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: delay=V/Q; V=2 L; Q=0.5 L/min; calculation 2/0.5 = 4 min. Applicability: Ideal mean bypass residence time.
steps.failure: 停滯旁流管可能讓感測值落後於主流。
steps.failureEn: A stagnant bypass can lag the main stream.
steps.check: 變更旁流量並比較事件到達時間。
steps.checkEn: Vary bypass flow and compare event arrival time.

steps.title: 兩點校正斜率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Two-point calibration slope: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 兩點校正斜率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Two-point calibration slope and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 斜率校正把輸出尺度連回已知標準；零點與斜率必須分開估計。
steps.instructionEn: Slope calibration ties output scale to known standards; estimate offset and slope separately.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：m=(y2-y1)/(x2-x1); y1=1.1,y2=5.3;x1=1,x2=5；計算 (5.3-1.1)/(5-1) = 1.05 output/input。適用限制：線性區間的兩點估計。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: m=(y2-y1)/(x2-x1); y1=1.1,y2=5.3;x1=1,x2=5; calculation (5.3-1.1)/(5-1) = 1.05 output/input. Applicability: Two-point estimate within a linear range.
steps.failure: 用兩點完全擬合不能證明全範圍線性。
steps.failureEn: Exact two-point fitting does not prove full-range linearity.
steps.check: 增加第三個獨立標準檢查線性殘差。
steps.checkEn: Use a third independent standard to check linearity residual.

steps.instruction: 已知y=mx+b時，應先扣b再除m；順序錯誤會留下系統偏差。

steps.check: 對三筆模擬讀值套用正反轉換並比對。
steps.checkEn: Apply forward and inverse transforms to three simulated readings.

steps.title: 溫度補償的基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Reference temperature compensation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 溫度補償的基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Reference temperature compensation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 導電度隨溫度變化；補償係數需符合水質與溫區，不能當所有感測器的通用公式。
steps.instructionEn: Conductivity varies with temperature; its compensation coefficient depends on water and range and is not a universal sensor formula.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：EC25=ECT/[1+alpha(T-25)]; ECT=1100;alpha=0.02;T=30；計算 1100/(1+0.02*(30-25)) = 1000 microS/cm。適用限制：示範線性導電度補償。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: EC25=ECT/[1+alpha(T-25)]; ECT=1100;alpha=0.02;T=30; calculation 1100/(1+0.02*(30-25)) = 1000 microS/cm. Applicability: Illustrative linear conductivity compensation.
steps.failure: 把補償後讀值再補償一次會重複修正。
steps.failureEn: Compensating an already corrected value applies the correction twice.
steps.check: 固定鹽度，在兩個溫度檢查補償後是否一致。
steps.checkEn: Hold salinity fixed and compare compensated readings at two temperatures.

steps.instruction: 重複量測可估隨機變動，但多次讀取同一偏移不會消除系統誤差。

steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: u_mean=s/sqrt(n); s=0.2;n=16; calculation 0.2/sqrt(16) = 0.05 unit. Applicability: Independent identically distributed readings, not strongly autocorrelated streams.
steps.failure: 把高度自相關的100筆視為100個獨立樣本會低估誤差。
steps.failureEn: Treating100 autocorrelated readings as100 independent samples understates uncertainty.
steps.check: 比較連續密集讀值與間隔取樣的自相關。
steps.checkEn: Compare autocorrelation of dense readings and spaced samples.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創假想教學算例：delay=V/Q; V=2 L; Q=0.5 L/min；計算 2/0.5 = 4 min。適用限制：理想旁流平均時間。
workedExample.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: delay=V/Q; V=2 L; Q=0.5 L/min; calculation 2/0.5 = 4 min. Applicability: Ideal mean bypass residence time.

title: 人工濕地水質淨化
summary: 以「水力停留、氧化還原與季節性淨化」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow hydraulic residence, redox and seasonal treatment through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察

steps.title: 負荷與功能定位：機制與觀察

steps.instruction: 人工濕地是受水力與污染負荷限制的處理單元；面積綠化不能直接代表淨化能力。

steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: organic load=Q C/1000;Q=100 m3/day;C=80 mg/L; calculation 100*80/1000 = 8 kg/day. Applicability: Illustrative influent BOD load without assumed removal.
steps.failure: 只依面積比例增加進水可能超出氧與水力能力。
steps.failureEn: Increasing feed by area ratio alone can exceed oxygen or hydraulic capacity.
steps.check: 保持濃度，將流量加倍比較負荷。
steps.checkEn: Keep concentration fixed and double flow to compare loading.

steps.checkEn: Halve conductivity and estimate required head difference.

steps.title: 蒸散與降雨收支：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Evapotranspiration and rainfall balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 蒸散與降雨收支 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Evapotranspiration and rainfall balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 降雨、蒸散和滲漏都會改變出水量；濃度變高可能源自水分流失而非污染增加。
steps.instructionEn: Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage alter outflow; higher concentration may result from water loss rather than increased pollutant mass.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：Qout=Qin+P A-ET A;Qin=50;P=0.002;ET=0.005;A=500；計算 50+0.002*500-0.005*500 = 48.5 m3/day。適用限制：無儲水變動、無滲漏的日平均。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: Qout=Qin+P A-ET A;Qin=50;P=0.002;ET=0.005;A=500; calculation 50+0.002*500-0.005*500 = 48.5 m3/day. Applicability: Daily mean without storage change or leakage.
steps.failure: 只比較進出濃度會誤判稀釋或濃縮。
steps.failureEn: Concentration-only comparison misreads dilution or concentration.
steps.check: 把乾季與雨季水量及質量收支分開。
steps.checkEn: Separate dry-season and wet-season water and mass balances.

steps.instruction: 前處理攔住顆粒可延緩根區堵塞；維護依沉積與水位趨勢安排。
steps.instructionEn: Pretreatment intercepts solids and delays root-zone clogging; schedule maintenance from sediment and head trends.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：deposited volume=M/rho;M=600 kg;rho=1200 kg/m3；計算 600/1200 = 0.5 m3。適用限制：沉積乾質量與假想堆積密度。

steps.failureEn: Waiting for blockage can force system bypass.

steps.checkEn: Compare sediment accumulation when pretreatment removal changes.

title: 屋頂綠化排水與防水

summaryEn: Follow water, weight and waterproofing interfaces in green roofs through ten technical units. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

steps.failureEn: Using dry-roof capacity during repeated storms overstates retention.
steps.check: 把初始含水率提高，重算剩餘容量。
steps.checkEn: Raise initial moisture and recalculate remaining storage.

scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

title: 生態滯留雨水花園
summary: 以「從街道逕流到雨水花園的滯留與處理」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow detention and treatment from street runoff to rain gardens through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

steps.failure: 只量表土入滲可能漏掉下方低滲層。
steps.failureEn: Surface testing can miss a less permeable lower layer.
steps.check: 將入滲率減半，檢查下一場雨前是否退水。
steps.checkEn: Halve infiltration and check drawdown before the next storm.

steps.objective: 完成 溢流與安全通路 的量測或模型練習，記錄與假設的差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete the measurement/model exercise for Overflow and safe routing and record deviations from assumptions.
steps.instruction:
用超設計事件追蹤溢流是否進入行人通道。

Track overflow during an extreme teaching event and check pedestrian paths.
Action: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for overflow and safe routing, first reproduce 13 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. steps.check: 保持相似雨量比較兩季退水曲線。
steps.checkEn: Compare seasonal drawdown curves under similar storms.

environmentExample.description: 事件監測與維護觸發~Event monitoring and maintenance triggers

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創假想教學算例：V=C P A;C=0.9;P=0.03 m;A=1000 m2；計算 0.9*0.03*1000 = 27 m3。適用限制：未模擬時間分布。
workedExample.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: V=C P A;C=0.9;P=0.03 m;A=1000 m2; calculation 0.9*0.03*1000 = 27 m3. Applicability: No time distribution modeled.

title: 透水鋪面孔隙維護
summary: 以「孔隙堵塞、清掃復原與承載排水協調」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow pore clogging, cleaning recovery and structural drainage through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 有效透水面積：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Effective permeable area: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 有效透水面積 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Effective permeable area and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 只有連通且未被覆蓋的面積參與入滲；施工封閉、塗層和補丁需單獨標示。
steps.instructionEn: Only connected uncovered area infiltrates; map closures, coatings and patches separately.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：Aeff=A(1-fblocked);A=500;fblocked=0.08；計算 500*(1-0.08) = 460 m2。適用限制：面積帳目，不表示入滲能力均一。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: Aeff=A(1-fblocked);A=500;fblocked=0.08; calculation 500*(1-0.08) = 460 m2. Applicability: Area accounting does not imply uniform infiltration.
steps.failure: 把不透水補丁仍算透水面會高估排水。
steps.failureEn: Counting impermeable patches overstates drainage.
steps.check: 標出停車格補丁並更新有效面積。
steps.checkEn: Map parking-space patches and update effective area.

knowledge.title: 有效透水面積
knowledge.text: 只有連通且未被覆蓋的面積參與入滲；施工封閉、塗層和補丁需單獨標示。

steps.failure: 只依面積大者優先可能漏掉關鍵出入口。
steps.failureEn: Area-only priority can miss critical entrances.
steps.check: 對三個分區排序並說明資料不足處。
steps.checkEn: Rank three zones and note data gaps.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創假想教學算例：Aeff=A(1-fblocked);A=500;fblocked=0.08；計算 500*(1-0.08) = 460 m2。適用限制：面積帳目，不表示入滲能力均一。
workedExample.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: Aeff=A(1-fblocked);A=500;fblocked=0.08; calculation 500*(1-0.08) = 460 m2. Applicability: Area accounting does not imply uniform infiltration.
